demand.statement: Crop Protection legacy portfolio growing YoY; CDMO demand deferred to H2; Chinese competition pressuring pricing
demand.quote: Our legacy portfolio remains the main growth driver with increasing volumes. In CDMO, demand was deferred to H2 and margins stayed under pressure.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin at 10.3%, H1 at 9.8%
margin.quote: I'm pleased to report our performance for Q2 and H1 FY27 with the Q2 revenue standing at INR434 crores with an EBITDA of INR45 crores and a margin of 10.3%. For H1 FY27, revenue stood at INR837 crores with an EBITDA of INR82 crores and a margin of 9.8%.

margin.statement: Crop Protection EBIT margin negative 1.5% in Q2, negative 2.5% in H1
margin.quote: For Q2 FY27, the Crop Protection business reported revenue of INR156 crores, EBIT of negative INR2 crores and an EBIT margin of negative 1.5%. For H1 FY27, the Crop Protection business reported revenue of INR326 crores and EBIT of negative INR8 crores and an EBIT margin of negative 2.5%.

margin.statement: US FDA remediation adding ~INR20 cr annual fixed cost; removing it would bring EBITDA margins to 17-18%
margin.quote: If you take that out of the way, then our EBITDA margins at the end of this year will be closer to 17%, 18%, if you remove this INR20 crores.

order_book.statement: Animal Health targeting INR400 cr revenue by FY30 from multiple customers and CDMO pipeline
order_book.quote: The business remains an important growth platform, and we continue to work towards our overall ambition of growing the business to about INR400 crores by FY '30.

order_book.statement: Signed multiyear CDMO contract with European agrochemical major; commercial launch end FY27, peak revenue INR50-75 cr by CY29/30
order_book.quote: We have signed a multiyear contract with a European-based global agrochemical company to supply a specialized product to markets worldwide. Commercial launch is expected towards the end of this financial year with volumes anticipated to grow progressively as regulatory approvals are secured across global markets.

capex.statement: H1 capex INR81 cr for debottlenecking, inventory, regulatory upgrades, selective capacity creation
capex.quote: Capital expenditure stood at INR81 crores incurred towards debottlenecking, inventory, regulatory upgrades and selective capacity creation.

pricing_cost.statement: Raw material prices up over 100% for key solvents/commodities; majority in CDMO to be passed on over next few quarters
pricing_cost.quote: Elevated raw material prices have impacted, as Sameer has mentioned, our margins this year with key solvents and certain commodity prices increasing sharply by over 100%. Some of the raw material costs has increased by over 100%. Majority of these increases in our CDMO business, which will be passed on to the customer over the next few quarters.

product_mix.statement: Pharma shifting from Gabapentin to higher-margin new molecules in diabetes, gastro, CNS, cardio, oncology
product_mix.quote: In the diabetes portfolio, in the gastro portfolio, in the CNS portfolio, in the cardio portfolio. We have a couple of molecules every year we're launching and commercializing. And oncology is a new area that we'll be launching very shortly as well.

risk.statement: H2 margin recovery dependent on war situation normalizing; otherwise 100bps variance possible
risk.quote: See, the issue is that the war situation is maybe having some impact. If the war situation normalizes, we should be able to achieve that. But otherwise, it may be 100 basis points here and there, not more than that.

other.statement: Pharma capacity utilization 60-70% due to quality compliance slowdown; Panoli pilot plant operational for DMF filings
other.quote: Capacity utilization during the quarter ranged from 60% to 70% at our pharma manufacturing facilities as we consciously slowed down production to comply with stringent quality standards.

other.statement: Debt-to-equity ratio 0.52 as of 30 Sep 2026; growth financed via internal accruals and external debt
other.quote: As of 30th September 2026, our debt-to-equity ratio stood at 0.52.

guidance.statement: Expect to become debt-free within next 2 years unless major capex arises
guidance.quote: You can fairly assume in the next 2 years, we should be definitely a debt-free company, unless any decisions taken otherwise.

guidance.statement: Will provide 2-3 year CAGR growth projection and category-wise capital allocation plan around February-March after 10 quarters of consistent growth
guidance.quote: What would be our CAGR directions in the future is something that we are compiling together, and precisely the reason why we said that somewhere probably around February - March is where we would be best suited

demand.statement: Consumption trends resilient despite uneven monsoon and inflation; rural demand uncertainty from subpar rainfall; alkaline battery volume up 30% YoY
demand.quote: Alkaline batteries continued to be a key contributor, registering a year -on-year volume growth of 30% in Q2 FY27, reflecting the increasing consumer preference for high-performance batteries

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA INR 53.8 crores, up 8.9% YoY; PAT INR 31.9 crores vs loss of INR 7.9 crores (incl. INR 37.7 cr exceptional loss last year)
margin.quote: EBITDA grew by 8.9% year-on-year to INR 53.8 crores, with an EBITDA margin of 12.6%. Profit after tax was at INR 31.9 crores against a loss of INR 7.9 crores

margin.statement: EBITDA margin 12.6% in Q2 FY27, down 20 bps YoY due to elevated material cost, channel and product mix; contained via calibrated price increases
margin.quote: If you see the current quarter, the margin compression is 20 bps and this is primarily because of the very high elevated material cost and some channel mix and the product mix.

margin.statement: Local alkaline manufacturing at Jammu currently 6-7% better margin vs imported; at stable forex/commodity would be 12-13% better; margin improvement gradual over 1 year as vendor localization progresses
margin.quote: If all the variables were stable, which means the forex was stable, the commodity was at the same price, etcetera., the MRP were the same, the local manufacturing would at least have ensured 12 to 13% accrual over imported prices any day

capex.statement: Jammu plant capital subsidy under NCSS: registration pending; if approved, eligible for INR 20-25 crores annually for 10 years from commercial production date
capex.quote: So, if it comes on our production, so it could be in the tune of INR 20 crores to INR 25 crores annually we can get it for the next 10 years

capex.statement: Jammu plant commercial production started May 2026; billing from September; depreciation increased by INR 1.5 crores QoQ due to capitalization
capex.quote: Yes, because here this quarter, as Jammu has been capitalized, and because of this Jammu capitalization, the depreciation has increased. It will continue coming going forward.

capex.statement: No major capex on the cards currently; Jammu plant investment ~INR 200 crores already made
capex.quote: Unless until there are any major capex comes, but at this point there is no major capex on the card.

pricing_cost.statement: Zinc prices up 36% YoY on average; inflationary pressures across chemicals, basic metals, electrical equipment; calibrated pricing actions taken
pricing_cost.quote: Zinc prices remained elevated, registering a 36% increase on an average compared to prices per ton in the corresponding period last year.

pricing_cost.statement: LED pricing erosion softened; several players including Eveready took price increases to mitigate cost inflation; electrical accessories, wires, MCBs resistant to price erosion
pricing_cost.quote: The pricing erosion has softened because many players over the last few months, including us, have taken price increases while the costs continue to be on the harder side.

product_mix.statement: Launched portable liquid mosquito vaporizer (patent-applied), SHOR rechargeable flashlight with animal alarm, Xtrabright emergency LED bulb (2x brighter)
product_mix.quote: A key focus area is our recently introduced portable liquid mosquito vaporiser, which combines the convenience of a rechargeable design with effective mosquito protection.

fund_raise.statement: Noida land sale: first plot proceeds received in March; second plot closed Oct 13, 2026 for INR 90 crores; impact visible in Q3 reporting
fund_raise.quote: Second part, we have successfully concluded which you have given to notes to accounts also on 13th October 2026, we have also closed the deal of the second plot.

other.statement: Net debt at INR 153 crores as of September; INR 90 crores from Noida land sale received in October used largely for debt reduction
other.quote: So, I was saying INR153 crores does not include the impact of the INR90 crores which you have received.

other.statement: Q2 FY27 revenue INR 428.2 crores, up 10.7% YoY; 8th consecutive quarter of YoY revenue growth
other.quote: Revenue for the quarter stood at INR 428.2 crores, registering a growth of 10.7% year-on-year.

guidance.statement: Revenue growth guidance 10-12% for FY27
guidance.quote: the margin guidance on the top line remains at 10% to 12%, as well as on the margin side.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin guidance 35-40% for Seaways
guidance.quote: we are coming slowly to the moderate margin structure of about 35-40% EBITDA, maybe 38% also.

guidance.statement: Capex guidance Rs 500-550 crore for FY27
guidance.quote: In terms of the overall CAPEX, I think we've been guiding at about 500, 550 -ish. I think we should get to about that level.

guidance.statement: Supply chain growth guidance 10-15% for FY27
guidance.quote: we are committed to a 10-15 percent higher on the higher teen side growth for this financial year also.

demand.statement: Strong demand from heavy engineering, electrical, quick commerce sectors
demand.quote: we are seeing enough and more demand coming from certain types of customers on the heavy engineering, on the electrical side of the businesses.

margin.statement: Seaways EBITDA margin 30-35% to 40% reasonable range
margin.quote: 30 -ish percent, 30-35%, to 40% is what we think is a reasonable number.

margin.statement: Freight division margins lowish/flattish, in rebuilding phase
margin.quote: Margins remain lowish to the flattish, but now we are seeing that some of this will start picking up.

margin.statement: Supply chain margins slightly up
margin.quote: Margins are slightly up, as you can see, and we again think that some of this growth will continue.

order_book.statement: Strong pipeline of contracts in supply chain transportation and warehousing
order_book.quote: we've got very strong pipeline in terms of contracts, both on the transportation side, as well as on the warehouse side.

capex.statement: Capex plan Rs 600 crore for FY27, 20-25% funded by debt
capex.quote: We do have a capex plan of 600 crores. And out of that, probably another 20% or 25% would be from the external borrowing.

capex.statement: Adding one more railway rake this quarter
capex.quote: we are also in the process of adding one more rake this quarter.

capex.statement: Capex spent ~Rs 300 crore in H1 FY27, full year target Rs 500-550 crore
capex.quote: We have made almost a similar investment in Capex. The Capex investment is almost as similar as what we've done the full year last year for six months already.

pricing_cost.statement: Freight rates increased 10-15% to pass on diesel/bunker cost hikes
pricing_cost.quote: we've also increased the freight rates by not almost necessarily the same amount, but about 10 -15% whatever the market can absorb.

pricing_cost.statement: Two-thirds of freight revenue growth pricing-led, one-third volume
pricing_cost.quote: In this case, I think it's been maybe two-thirds of it is pricing and one-third is volume.

product_mix.statement: LTL share at 37%, inching up; FTL growth also decent
product_mix.quote: the LTL share is still at about 37%. It's starting to inch up, but we are also seeing decent amount of growth in the FTL side.

risk.statement: Shipping market highly unpredictable with bunker price volatility and freight rate swings
risk.quote: the volatility in the market is so high right now. It is just unbelievable. We are seeing that the bunker prices have been oscillating nonstop for the past month.

risk.statement: Freight rate increases limited by modal shift risk to rail/road
risk.quote: if the freight rates on the sea go up too much also, customers can shift to rail or to other modes of transport. So there's a right balance that we must keep also in the business.

other.statement: Capex funding 20-25% from external borrowing for leverage and tax advantage
other.quote: And out of that, probably another 20% or 25% would be from the external borrowing. This is because of leverage and tax advantage.

other.statement: Promoter holding increased to 70% post buyback
other.quote: And we have the promoter holding has subsequently gone up to 70%.

guidance.statement: Management expects early double-digit growth for Tech & Digital segment over next 3 years
guidance.quote: if you ask for the next 3 years term, again, we should look at an early double-digit growth, specifically as a T&D as a segment. That's the guidance or the strategy that we are working towards.

guidance.statement: BPM segment margins expected to continue improving as domestic business is reduced
guidance.quote: We will continue to see upliftment in the overall BPM business margin as we progress and do away with this domestic business.

guidance.statement: Employee cost to revenue ratio expected to continue dropping
guidance.quote: We will continue to see a reduction in the head count as we progress and our ratio of employee cost to revenue should continue to drop as we move forward.

guidance.statement: Lease payments expected to remain in same range as FY26 (INR35 crores) for FY27
guidance.quote: I think that would be the fair base. It can actually come down as we continue to optimize in terms of resources, etc. However, having said this, it all depends as to what is the kind of new business that we get and how many new lease we may have to take to support growth. But the current guidance is, whatever current lease that we have, we're going to be in the same range.

demand.statement: International BPM grew 12.6% YoY in Q2 and now contributes 83% of BPM revenue
demand.quote: International BPM continues to be a key growth driver, growing 12.6% year-on-year in Q2 and now contributing approximately 83% of the BPM revenue compared to 75% in the corresponding quarter last year.

demand.statement: Tech & Digital revenue grew 12.9% YoY in Q2 with segment margin of 43.9%
demand.quote: Our Tech & Digital business continued its growth momentum, delivering 12.9% year-on-year revenue growth in Q2, with segment margin improving to 43.9%.

demand.statement: New business ACV of INR37.2 crores in Q2, up 86.5% YoY; H1 ACV of INR82.6 crores more than doubled YoY
demand.quote: During Q2, we secured new business with an annual contract value of INR37.2 crores, growing 86.5% year-on-year. For H1, our new business ACV reached INR82.6 crores, more than doubling compared to the last year.

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin expanded to 30.2% in Q2 from 24.4% YoY and 27.5% QoQ
margin.quote: EBITDA margin expanded to 30.2% compared to 24.4% in Q2 last year and 27.5% in the previous quarter.

margin.statement: BPM segment margin improved to 15.6% in Q2 from 11.6% YoY and 11.9% QoQ
margin.quote: In the BPM segment, quarter 2 segment margins stood at INR17.5 crores with a segment margin improving to 15.6% compared to 11.6% in Q2 last year and 11.9% in the preceding quarter.

margin.statement: Tech & Digital segment margin at 43.9% in Q2 and 43.4% for H1
margin.quote: In the Tech & Digital, quarter 2 segment margin was INR18.3 crores, which winding strong segment margin of 43.9%.

order_book.statement: H1 new ACV of INR82.6 crores (INR66.5 crores BPM + INR16.1 crores Tech & Digital) more than doubled YoY
order_book.quote: For H1, our new business ACV reached INR82.6 crores, more than doubling compared to the last year. This includes INR66.5 crores from BPM and INR16.1 crores from Tech & Digital.

order_book.statement: Q2 new ACV of INR37.2 crores includes one Europe Tech & Digital deal of ~INR7 crores and one BOT model BPM deal of ~INR16.8 crores with potential to grow 4x
order_book.quote: On the Tech & Digital, I have 1 deal, which is basically a Europe client that we look at, which is about close to INR7 crores. This is a multiyear contract, which is on auto renewal because and T&D typically works that way doesn't have periods that we look at. And here, it's the segment margins that we follow. So typically, we'll be looking at somewhere about a 60% plus gross margin on this deal.

capex.statement: ROU assets increased to ~INR140 crores due to new office with longer lease commitment replacing old office
capex.quote: Why the ROU has increased is because we have replaced the old office with the new office, new office comes with the longer date of commitment, and therefore you see that lease liabilities are increasing.

product_mix.statement: Launched Buzzily 2.0 in May 2026, Alldigi 360 (full HCM SaaS suite) and Alldigi 360 Analytics (AI analytics module) in October 2026
product_mix.quote: We have -- in the month of May 2026, we launched Buzzily 2.0. And recently, in October, we launched 2 more products, Alldigi 360 and Alldigi 360 Analytics.

product_mix.statement: TaxSpanner partnership live since last year; targeting 10-12 lakh Indian employee records for IT return filing; revenue impact visible after Q4
product_mix.quote: However, we were bit late in terms of the previous financial year. So it was just early lukewarm response that we had last year. But this year, we should be able to capitalize on it. Given that I have close to about more than 10 to 12 lakh employee records in India. We will try and target in terms of how many employees can use TaxSpanner in terms of the IT returns that they can file. So I don't ha

risk.statement: NPS integration with payroll platform at early stage; too early to comment on revenue potential or 401(k)-like opportunity
risk.quote: In terms of your NPS integration, it's too early to say how the response is going to be. The 401(k) comparison to U.S. would not be an apple -to-apple comparison because that has been a very long existing process, and it is at a different scale. So if you a sk me 401(k) benefit is an entire industry and the service by itself in the U.S., maybe NPS can go there, but it is too early to comment

other.statement: New BOT model deal with 1,000+ FTEs expected to grow 2-3x; assisted captive/build-operate-transfer service launched
other.quote: One of our -- we've started with one of our clients. and it is already in progress as we speak today, it's relationship over 1,000 FTEs, which is expected to grow at least by another 2 or 3x. So that's a new service plan that we've added, and we are bringing in AI here as well in terms of our recruitment, training and why we do this.

other.statement: Cash and liquid funds INR127.2 crores as of Sep 2026; sequential reduction due to dividend payment
other.quote: Cash and liquid funds stood at INR127.2 crores at the end of September 2026. The sequential reduction largely reflects the dividend paid during the quarter, while the underlying business continued to generate healthy cash flows.

guidance.statement: Management declines to provide revenue growth guidance, stating a player of their size should not give guidance at this stage.
guidance.quote: No, I don't think so. I don't think there is any player of our size. I mean, you or any o f the investors can educate me if you need to, but we looked at this across the market. At a board level, we discussed this as well, and we don't think a player of our size should be giving guidance at this stage

demand.statement: Data center business is seeing extraordinary demand for high-density compute from hyperscalers and AI clouds, with new mandates driving record order book additions.
demand.quote: In data centers, rapid AI workload growth is creating extraordinary demand for high-density compute, and we are deepening our footprint through new mandates with leading hyperscalers.

demand.statement: Middle East deal action is meaningfully back, with hopes to announce significant wins in the region before year-end.
demand.quote: We do see deal action coming back in the Middle East. In fact, we do hope over the next quarter or two to announce some significant wins in the region.

demand.statement: Commercial activity in banking and fintech has picked up meaningfully with several large deals in advanced stages and multiple proofs of concept running across Asia and Europe.
demand.quote: Commercial activity has picked up meaningfully, with several large dea ls in advanced stages and multiple proofs of concept running across Asia, across Europe, led by our agentic AI workflows and AI -native platforms in transaction banking trade finance

margin.statement: Banking and fintech margins are at or slightly above expectations; transit margins trending up; data center margins below enterprise average but expected to improve as proprietary products are added.
margin.quote: On the banking and fintech side, I think we had a very strong H1. In general, margins are more or less where we expect them to be or slightly better. On the transit side, again, over the full year, margins have been trending up even beyond this year, and they'll continue to trend up.

margin.statement: Enterprise margin expected to stay flat at current levels in H2 due to data center revenue growing 70%-80% and diluting mix, offsetting improvements in banking and transit.
margin.quote: I think at a margin level, my expectation would be we more or less stay at the level where we are. Under the hood, the banking side will, of course, improve as we go into H2. The transit side will also improve slightly as we go into H2. But then you'll see the mix change to a level where because data center will probably grow 70%-80%, if not more, this year. If that happens, I think the mix will e

order_book.statement: Data center order book is north of 30% of total; overall split is probably two-thirds TIG and one-third banking and fintech.
order_book.quote: Yes, so it has picked up. I would say it is north of 30% now. Overall, I think the split is probably two-thirds, one-third now between the TIG side and banking and fintech side.

order_book.statement: Approximately 70%-75% of the order book is executable over the next 4-6 quarters; AMCs and recurring revenues are largely excluded from the order book.
order_book.quote: I would say the way one should look at the order book that exists right now, it used to be 80%. It's probably now 70%, 75% of it is executable over the next 4-6 quarters, I would think.

order_book.statement: Order book exceeds INR 2,000 crores; data center portion now north of 30% of total, with overall split roughly two-thirds TIG and one-third banking and fintech.
order_book.quote: We head into the second half backed by an order book of more than INR 2,000 crores, a deep pipeline, and accelerating execution.

capex.statement: Company is integrating backward to manufacture critical components for data centers and transit, controlling the stack end-to-end for quality, timelines, and unit economics.
capex.quote: Building on our proven transit manufacturing footprint, we are integrating backward to manufacture critical components for both next-generation data centers and mass transit networks.

pricing_cost.statement: R&D intensity peaked in H1 FY27 and will moderate; bulk of AI-native product build-out is complete, freeing capacity for revenue projects.
pricing_cost.quote: We believe the incremental intensity of this R&D ramp that we went through, it peaked in H1 and will moderate going forward.

product_mix.statement: New AI-native banking products (Verdict, Infinity OS, Lexsi Labs) launched; will ship brand-new AI-native software every quarter this year.
product_mix.quote: With our foundational architecture in place, we will ship brand-new AI-native software every single quarter this year, sometimes more than once in a quarter, helping clients turn this technology shift into measurable business results.

risk.statement: Cybersecurity identified as a growing threat and opportunity; practice established four quarters ago, building capabilities over next four quarters.
risk.quote: We set up the cybersecurity practice now four quarters back. We went in for the certification and stuff. Basically, we will build out a fairly strong set of capabilities on the cybersecurity side.

risk.statement: Data center project execution carries working capital and billing timing risks in early stages, but managed with discipline and factored into profitability.
risk.quote: obviously, there is a little bit of working capital requirement, I think, relat ive to the size of the business and the size of the opportunity and the size of the profit you can make in it. It is not super significant. But right now, there is a little bit of stress because we are starting off the projects and we are trying to sort of iron out some kinks in terms of how you bill and when you bill

other.statement: Data center capacity ramp is a key variable; projects are 12-14 months with increasing pressure to shrink timelines to 12-18 months.
other.quote: Typically, what we are seeing is these are 12, 14-month projects these days. There is an increasing pressure on timelines that we see at least on that business, where earlier clients were more prepared for a long gestation for projects, while now they are typically getting shrunk to 12 months or less, or 18 months or less.

other.statement: Targeting 60%-70% OCF-to-EBITDA conversion for FY27, with collections skewed to Q3 and Q4; data center unbilled revenue under control in Q3.
other.quote: I think something between 60% and 70% is doable, and I think that's what we will sort of stay focused on.

guidance.statement: FY27 sales guidance maintained at INR11,200 crores including Zentech transaction
guidance.quote: Our FY27 sales guidance remains INR11,200 crores, including the Zentech transaction.

demand.statement: Residential demand strong in South and West; no slowdown seen; consolidation benefits branded developers
demand.quote: I don't see that we have any kind of slowdown or some people use the word phasing out of the demand. I don't see that, and it will continue to be there.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 27%; project-level weighted average EBITDA margin ~30%
margin.quote: EBITDA was INR289 crores, representing margin of 27%.

order_book.statement: H1 FY27 total sales achievement INR4,200 crores, 37.5% of annual guidance
order_book.quote: Together these take our total sales achievement for the first half of year to INR4,200 crores or 37.51% of our annual sales guidance of INR11,200 crores.

capex.statement: Hebbal project requires ~INR700 crores construction capex; Aerocity Phase 2 needs ~INR450 crores over 4 years
capex.quote: Hebbal, after the land cost, it will require close to INR700 crores for the 1.3 million-odd square feet that we are developing over there.

pricing_cost.statement: Redevelopment saves ~60% initial capital outlay vs land purchase; cost ~40% of land value including tenant compensation
pricing_cost.quote: if we go and buy and do a redevelopment versus buying a land, we incur, including the tenants and the members, cost and corpuses that we pay, the cost comes to around 40% of the overall land value.

product_mix.statement: Miami ultra-luxury pre-launch at INR1.55 lakh/sq ft; 3 transactions during demolition phase
product_mix.quote: The current price on which we are doing transactions is all in the range of INR1.55 lakh per square feet.

risk.statement: Cuffe Parade launch may slip to April-May next fiscal; some South projects may push to next year
risk.quote: There might be a chance that Cuffe Parade might move to April -May for next financial year.

other.statement: FY27 collection guidance INR6,000 crores; operating surplus target >INR1,000 crores
other.quote: We had given guidance that we'll be doing a collections of about INR6,000 crores for the year as a whole and operating surplus. We had done last year about -- we'll be crossing INR1,000 crores mark as operating surplus.

other.statement: H1 FY27 handed over 1,722 homes (977 in Q2); consistent delivery priority
other.quote: We handed over 977 homes covering approximately 0.97 million square feet during the quarter, taking first half handover to 1,722 homes.

guidance.statement: H2 FY27 lubricant volume growth expected at 2x-3x industry average of 3-4%, targeting near double-digit growth
guidance.quote: We expect H2 to have the normal 3%, 4% growth which lubricant industry takes in terms of average lubricant growth, and we will do 2x to 3x that.

guidance.statement: AdBlue volume growth guidance maintained at 10-15% double-digit for H2 FY27 and next financial year
guidance.quote: So, we estimate that we should grow our AdBlue volumes by double-digit 10% to 15% is what our guidance has been in the past. So, we stick to that going forward.

demand.statement: Core lubricant volume grew 16% YoY in Q2 FY27 to 47,000 KL; H1 volume up 17% to 95,000 KL, 3-4x industry growth
demand.quote: Overall, our core lubricant volume was 47,000 KL versus last year 40,500 KL, which means we have added 6,500 KL during the quarter, and that gives us 16% growth.

demand.statement: AdBlue volume dipped to 33,000 KL in Q2 due to monsoon; H1 flat at 73,000 KL
demand.quote: AdBlue in this quarter, we all know that this was a monsoon quarter. So, there were some lesser movements of vehicles during this quarter, especially the truck movements are slightly lower because of monsoons.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin at 11.8%, near guided 12-14% band; per-litre margins protected despite inflation
margin.quote: And also, at the same time, it is important to note that we have been able to maintain our margins in more or less near to the guided band of 12% to 14%. The margins for the quarter are 11.8%.

order_book.statement: Tirex revenue INR 33 crore in Q2 FY27 (78% YoY growth from INR 18 crore); expanding into mining, construction, private buses
order_book.quote: I think Tirex, 78% growth in revenue. Of course, the bases are low, but still we have done, I think last year was INR 18 crore, now we have done about INR 33 crore plus.

capex.statement: Chennai expansion on track for completion by end of Q3 FY27; Silvassa expansion delayed 1-2 months to Q1 FY28; total capex ~INR 60-62 crore (INR 55 crore + INR 5-7 crore incremental)
capex.quote: We were estimating INR 55 crore earlier, which was announced. And we see that there is an incremental need of INR 5 crore to INR 7 crore, which the Board has sanctioned recently. So now the total capex for expansion is around INR 60 crore, INR 62 crore.

pricing_cost.statement: Three price hikes taken in B2C channel since September 2025; OEM contracts have quarterly/monthly price variation clauses; B2B negotiated separately
pricing_cost.quote: If we to give you an idea, in channel business, which is our B2C, we have taken 3 price increases so far. In OEM businesses, which is a good part of our business, we have quarterly price variation clauses.

product_mix.statement: Targeting synthetic products to reach 10% of portfolio over next 3-4 years
product_mix.quote: So just to tell you, that is another endeavor, which hopefully, in the second half, we will see definitely some traction. Yes, this is a range which we want to, over a period of next 3 to 4 years, make it synthetic range about 10% of our portfolio.

order_book.quote: For Q2 FY27, ICX Private Limited issued nearly 52 lakhs I -RECs, a growth of 38.4% Y -o-Y. Issuance in the first half of FY27 reached 94 lakhs, a growth of 15% over H1 FY26. Revenu e for ICX in Q2 FY27 stood at INR2.3 crores, higher by 20.8% on a year-on-year basis.

capex.statement: Indian Coal Exchange incorporated as wholly owned subsidiary; applied for license with Coal Controller Organisation in September 2026
capex.quote: With regards our initiative to build a coal exchange in India, IEX has incorporated Indian Coal Exchange Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary for this purpose. Recently in September, Indian Coal Exchange Limited applied for a license with Coal Controller Organisation, CCO, the regulatory body for coal exchanges.

pricing_cost.statement: Average DAM price rose 46% YoY to INR5.72/unit; average RTM price rose 49% YoY to INR5.24/unit in Q2 FY27
pricing_cost.quote: A weak monsoon increased buy bids in IEX day -ahead market by nearly 120% Y -o-Y in Q2, pushing up average DAM prices nearly 46% Y-o-Y to INR5.72 per unit and average RTM price higher by 49% Y-o-Y to INR5.24 per unit.

product_mix.statement: Awaiting CERC approval for TAM extension to 11 months, Green RTM contract, and Peak DAM/Peak RTM segments
product_mix.quote: With regard our product pipeline, we continue to await approval from the CERC on our petitions to extend the Term-Ahead Market contract from 3 months to 11 months; to introduce the Green RTM contract; and third, with regard to introduction of Peak DAM and Peak RTM segments.

product_mix.statement: TAM market share ~35% for many years; not a flagship product; DISCOMs spread participation across exchanges due to lower liquidity
product_mix.quote: TAM, our market share is lower. It hovers around 35% and it has been there for many years. The point there is that it is not dependent on the DISCOMs as such. It is being done by, generally the distribution companies, they have tendency to put something everywhere in all the exchanges. And then, as you know, this is not a very highly liquid market. Wherever there is a participation, it gets throug

risk.statement: Market coupling in RTM likely challenging due to tight timelines; CERC proposes reducing bidding to 5 minutes and clearing to 10 minutes from April 2027
risk.quote: And coupling in RTM is definitely going to be challenging. Earlier also (in RTM) when we had 15 minutes of bidding time and 15 minutes of market clearing time, the timelines were tight. Now as per CERC staff, if the bidding time is reduced to five minutes and clearing time to ten minutes from 1st of April (2027), I think the timelines will be further tight.

other.statement: DISCOMs contribute ~80% of buy-side volumes; majority participate directly via API integration for bidding and back-office reconciliation
other.quote: DISCOM s or distribution utilities are the major buyers. They are contributing to about 80% of the total volumes on the buy side that is being done. Majority of them are participating directly. Except for few DISCOMs, all of them are our members and they themselves participate. They do not participate through any of the trader member as such.

other.statement: ~80 GW thermal capacity under construction; 43 GW BESS awarded under viability gap funding; expect >100 GW battery storage by 2032
other.quote: I think almost about 80 gigawatt of thermal capacity is under construction. Similarly for batteries, BESS, also under the viability gap funding scheme, BESS of 43 gigawatt is already awarded. And then many of the States have also awarded Battery Energy Storage Systems. Under the merchant route also many of the IPPs are awarding it. So we expect by 2032 battery itself will be more than 100 gigawatt

guidance.statement: Targets 35% CAGR disbursement growth over 3 years and PAT of INR450-500 crores in FY29
guidance.quote: We are satisfied with the progress we are making towards targets shared with you in Q4 FY26 earnings calls, which was 35% CAGR disbursement growth over the next 3 years and PAT of INR450 crores to INR500 crores in FY29.

guidance.statement: Expects normalized credit cost of 2-2.5% and significant reduction from Q4 FY27
guidance.quote: We had guided that given very strong underwriting performance in new book, we would expect our normalized credit cost to remain between 2% to 2.5%.

guidance.statement: Targets 2% ROAA from H2 FY28 driven by credit cost reduction
guidance.quote: So we do want to target 2% ROAA from H2 FY28 because by that time, most of our old book would have run off.

guidance.statement: Plans 100 branch additions over next 3 years
guidance.quote: In Q4 FY26 earnings call, we had guided for 100 branch additions over the next 3 years.

demand.statement: Vehicle finance disbursements grew 47% YoY; Micro LAP disbursements grew 174% YoY
demand.quote: Year-on-year, we grew our overall disbursements by 51%, 47% in vehicle finance business and 174% in M/LAP business.

demand.statement: Retail disbursements grew 51% YoY to INR1,399 crores in Q2 FY27
demand.quote: During the quarter, retail disbursements stood at INR1,399 crores compared to INR1,235 crores in the previous quarter and INR927 crores in the corresponding period last year.

margin.statement: Weighted average cost of borrowing reduced to 9.7%; incremental borrowing cost at 9.1%
margin.quote: Our weighted average cost of borrowing reduced to 9.7%, while incremental borrowing cost stood at 9.1%.

order_book.statement: Retail AUM at INR8,459 crores (97% of total AUM) as of September 2026
order_book.quote: Retail assets under management stood at INR8,459 crores as of September 2026 and now accounts for 97% of our overall AUM.

order_book.statement: Micro LAP AUM at INR280 crores, up 177% YoY
order_book.quote: AUM closed the quarter at INR280 crores, up 177% year-on-year.

capex.statement: Will continue investing in field sales force and data science team
capex.quote: We will continue to invest further in field sales force to take full advantage of our large pan-India branch network.

pricing_cost.statement: Plans to pass on rate hikes to borrowers as peers are doing
pricing_cost.quote: I think pretty much most of our peers do plan to pass it on to the borrower and that's what we will do as well. So as our cost goes up, I think, pretty much all other NBFCs plan to pass it on, and we will be no different.

product_mix.statement: MHCV share down from 31% to 27%; Passenger vehicle share up from 23% to 31% over last year
product_mix.quote: Over the last 1 year, our MHCV disbursement share has come down from 31% to 27% and passenger vehicle share has gone up from 23% to 31%.

product_mix.statement: Targets no segment exceeding 35-40% concentration across 5 verticals
product_mix.quote: I think it's fair to say that you would expect us to not cross 35% to 40% in any other segment. That's where you will see us operating, basically avoid concentration in any of the segment that we operate.

risk.statement: Pre-Jan 2025 legacy book (~INR1,850 crores, 24% of AUM) still shows 27% 30+ delinquency
risk.quote: So as on 30th September 2026, this is around 24% of our total AUM, which still resides and which is showing a little higher delinquency or a significantly higher delinquency than our current trend, which is there, roughly give and take this fully amounts to around INR1,850-odd crores.

other.statement: Field sales force increased 51% from 1,235 to 1,868 over last year
other.quote: Our field sales force number has increased from about 1,235 to 1,868 over last 1 year, representing a growth of about 51%.

other.statement: Branch network expanded from 454 to 475 in last 2 quarters
other.quote: We are making steady progress and number of branches have increased from 454 to 475 in the last 2 quarters.

guidance.statement: Previously guided for INR18,000 crores revenue by FY2030, INR945 crores PAT, 20-25% PAT to OCF conversion, net debt-free by 2030
guidance.value: INR18,000 crores revenue, INR945 crores PAT
guidance.quote: We had earlier guided for INR18,000 crores revenue by FY2030, INR945 crores of PAT, 20% to 25% of PAT converted into operating cash flow, and a net debt-free balance sheet by 2030.

guidance.statement: Will revisit guidance after QIP fund raise mandate closes
guidance.quote: once this mandate is closed and considering our business is a turn-based business that we have highlighted in our speech, we will again revisit our numbers. And at that point of time, we can come back to the street with the updated set of guidance on conclusion of this fund raise.

guidance.statement: Management states they no longer provide forward guidance per SEBI guidelines and will let track record speak
guidance.quote: Under SEBI guidelines, we are not supposed to give forward -looking guidance. That is one of the reasons you have not seen future guidance in our latest quarter presentation. Today, I will speak only about what we have built and what we have delivered.

demand.statement: Seeing drastic karatage shift from 22K to 18K, 14K, 9K driven by gold price rise and younger buyers
demand.quote: From last two years, you can see historically we were a 22-karat company and now from last two years, strategically we are at 22-karat, 18-karat, 14-karat, and 9-karat. Every quarter, we are seeing that there's a drastic change in the karatage shift from 22-karat shifting to 18-karat, 18-karat shifting to 14-karat and 9-karat.

margin.statement: Gross margin improvement driven by advance gold at 16% of volumes (adds 110 bps) and studded jewelry at 2.6% of revenue
margin.quote: First, advance gold was 16% of our business in Q2 '27, ahead of our '27 target of 15%. Because we billed only making charges, i t adds 110 basis points to gross margin while needing almost no working capital. Second, studded jewellery continued to gain share, with natural and lab -grown diamond jewellery now about 2.6% of revenue for Q2 FY27.

margin.statement: Historically guided for 5-5.25% PAT margins and 8% gross margins; past margin guidance remains on track
margin.quote: We have in the past guided for 5% to 5.25% of PAT margins. Due to compliance restriction, we cannot comment on future guidance , but our past margin percentage guidance remains on track. Furthe r, any improvement on gross margin will be deployed back into the

order_book.statement: Exports grew from INR35 crores in FY23 to INR435 crores in Q2 FY27 (INR1,600 crores annualized), now 18% of business
order_book.value: INR435 crores quarterly, INR1,600 crores annualized
order_book.quote: In FY23, our annual exports were only about INR35 crores. In Q2 FY27, we have reached exports of INR435 crores. I repeat it FY23 as a whole we did INR35 crores of exports, while in current quarter alone we have achieved INR435 crores. Today, exports are ro ughly 18% of our business, around INR1,600 crores plus on annualized basis.

capex.statement: Invested in design team (15-20 to 180 CAD designers), 40 3D printing machines, direct casting, laser cutting, hollow stamping, ERP system
capex.quote: We adopted 3D printing with paper casting as early as 2020, and now run 40 such machines. Together with direct casting, laser cutting , hollow stamping, this makes our jewelry 20% to 30% lighter. We have also cut gold loss from 1.5% to 0.5%.

product_mix.statement: Added mangalsutra and uncut diamond categories via Starmangalsutra, Rishabh Gold, Purvi Gems acquisitions
product_mix.quote: Mangalsutra and uncut diamond, we have added this through acquisitions, which I will come to next. The result is the blend we set out to build: an advanced metal business where ROIC is effectively infinite, a diamond business with high margins and a value-added gold business that now makes up significant part of our revenues.

fund_raise.statement: Announced new fund raise (QIP enabling provision); SEBI norms prevent disclosing use of proceeds
fund_raise.quote: I know many of you have questions about the fundraise we announced recently. In line with the regulatory guidelines, I am not allowed to speak about its specific purpose or the use of proceeds.

fund_raise.statement: Raised INR25.56 crores IPO (2018), INR128 crores preferential (2023), INR270 crores QIP (Oct 2024); total ~INR398 crores equity for 18x revenue growth
fund_raise.quote: Put simply, across these two funds raised post our IPO, we have taken in about INR398 crores of equity. Over the same period , revenue has grown from INR500 crores to INR9,000 crores plus, roughly 18x.

risk.statement: Land monetization at advanced due diligence; if no buyer in 20-30 days, promoters will buy (avoiding related party transaction)
risk.quote: So, we were very close to purchase of this land ourselves last month, but there was buyer who has shown a strong interest and the process is at advanced stage of due diligence. If we don't get a final commitment in this next 20 or 30 days, the promoters will purchase. But we intend not to be a related party transaction, that's why we have stretched one or two months.

risk.statement: Star Mangalsutra fraud incident: INR10.7 crores involved, INR3.35 crores recovered, balance fully provided in Q2 FY27
risk.value: INR10.7 crores fraud, INR3.35 crores recovered
risk.quote: This is after an exceptional charge of INR7.35 crores for the fraud incident at our subsidiary, Star Mangalsutra , disclosed in July. Of the INR10.70 crores involved, INR3.35 crores has been recovered, and the balance is fully provided this quarter.

other.statement: Receivables 33 days (down from 39 days Sep'25, up from 26 days Mar'26); seasonal spike due to festive billing
other.quote: Receivable days were 33 at September end, down from 39 days in September '25, against March '26 at 26 days. They are higher and I want to explain why. September end, it is a peak season of festive dispatches.

other.statement: Advance Gold model at 16% of volumes (ahead of 15% target), adds 110 bps to gross margin with near-zero working capital
other.quote: First, advance gold was 16% of our business in Q2 '27, ahead of our '27 target of 15%. Because we billed only making charges, i t adds 110 basis points to gross margin while needing almost no working capital.

guidance.statement: Aim to reach INR10,000 crores AUM by March 2028
guidance.quote: So I would say that at this point in time, we are aiming for at least near-term aim is to reach a INR10,000 crores mark by March '28.

guidance.statement: Target ROA of 3.5-4% and ROE of 14-15% from FY27 onwards in BAU scenario
guidance.quote: We should get to the ROA of 3.5% to 4%, which is what we have stated. And we're very confident that, that looks like will play out. ROE accordingly, with a 4x gearing should be closer to 14%, 15%, thereabouts.

guidance.statement: Gross credit cost expected to hover between 2.5-3%; net credit cost guidance uncertain due to Maharashtra situation
guidance.quote: The gross always, I said 2.5% to 3%, and we are holding good because even if you have a 99% - 99.5% collection efficiency, even if you flow 0.5%, you flow 6% during the course of the year, 50%, if you are able to collect, it's going to be around 2.5% to 3% gross.

guidance.statement: No change in FY27 guidance: INR6,000-6,500 crores disbursements, INR6,000+ crores AUM, INR675 crores opex as of end October
guidance.quote: See, as of now, end of October, we stand where we had said we will stand as of March '27. So no change in forecast.

margin.statement: Yield improved to 24.9% in Q2 FY27 from 24.6% in Q1 FY27
margin.quote: We are at 24.9%, up from 24.6% compared to Q1.

margin.statement: NIM improved to 13.6% in Q2 FY27 from 12.5% in Q1 FY27
margin.quote: NIM has improved to 13.6% compared to 12.5%, which is output of both improvement in the yield as well as reduction in the financial cost.

margin.statement: Marginal cost of borrowing declined to 10.6% in Q2 FY27, down 260 bps from 13.2% in Q3 FY26
margin.quote: Our marginal cost, like I've explained, is now at 10.6%, which is a decline of 260 basis points since Q3 FY26.

order_book.statement: Added 1.5 lakh new borrowers in Q2 FY27, a 10% increase over previous quarter
order_book.quote: We managed to add about 1.5 lakh new subscribers or consumers, which again showed a 10% increase over the previous quarter.

order_book.statement: AUM crossed INR5,000 crores for the first time in recent quarters, showing 10% QoQ growth
order_book.quote: Our AUM stood at INR5,364 crores, which was a healthy 10% growth quarter-on-quarter.

capex.statement: New LOS piloted, full branch migration expected over next couple of months
capex.quote: The new LOS that I spoke of in the last quarter has got piloted, and we hope to complete the entire migration of our branches over the next couple of months.

pricing_cost.statement: Micro-LAP pricing 19-22%, tenure 7-10 years, LTV ~60% (up to 65%)
pricing_cost.quote: Tenure will be 7 to 10 years, ideally 7 to 8 years with some exceptions around 8 to 10 years. The LTV is going to be about 60%. In some cases, may go up to 65%. And pricing, again, we are looking between 19% and 22%.

product_mix.statement: Post-merger portfolio mix: 60-70% JLG, ~20% cash, 1-2% individual loans, 8-10% micro-LAP
product_mix.quote: And even in a post-merger scenario, your JLG loans will continue to be 60%, 70%, another 20%-odd will be cash, 1% or 2% could be individual loans, 8%, 10% would be micro-LAP.

product_mix.statement: Micro-LAP book at INR305 crores across 6 states; target INR1,000 crores in 2-3 years; ticket size shifted to INR5-15/20 lakh
product_mix.value: INR305 crores current, INR1,000 crores target
product_mix.quote: Book is currently about INR305-odd crores. Ambition is to take it to INR1,000 crores over the next 2- 3 years.

fund_raise.statement: Raised INR194 crores in second tranche of partly paid shares; 97% of first tranche subscribers participated
fund_raise.quote: We have managed to raise INR194 crores of second tranche of partly paid shares, thereby 97% of the subscribers participated in the first tranche, participated in the second tranche as well.

fund_raise.statement: Raised INR1,622 crores debt in Q2 FY27 including INR995 crores under CGS scheme; closing liquidity INR1,379 crores
fund_raise.quote: During the quarter, we have raised INR1,622 crores and this included the CGS, like Venky explained, INR995 crores. We are maintaining a very strong liquidity position with a closing liquidity of INR1,379 crores as of September 30.

risk.statement: Maharashtra drought risk: INR600 crores exposure in Karnataka+Maharashtra, 96% current, 3% GNPA; 18 critical branches identified in Maharashtra
risk.quote: Fortunately, our book is about INR600 crores in these 2 states put together, of which about 96% of the portfolio is in current status, 3% is in the GNPA.

risk.statement: Expect clarity on drought impact by December-January; November should show first signals
risk.quote: And again, it's too early days because with the spread of these days, with the way social media plays out, you never get to really know the intensity of either the good thing or the bad thing because you got to take everything with a pinch of salt. So hopefully, by December, November should indi cate the first signs of signals should come through in November. By December, January, you should have

other.statement: GNPA reduced to 2.5% in Q2 FY27 from 3.6% in Q1 FY27; NNPA reduced to 0.5% from 0.68%
other.quote: GNPA has come down to 2.5% against 3.6%. NNPA has reduced to 0.5% against 0.68%.

other.statement: X-bucket collection efficiency improved to 99.6% from a low of 96.2% over last 2 years
other.quote: Today, if we see the X-bucket collection efficiency, which at a point in time was as low as 96.2% over last 2 years at a particular point in time, today is at 99.6%.

guidance.statement: Aiming for mid-teen MDF volume growth for full year FY27
guidance.quote: We are aiming to achieve mid-teen MDF volume growth for the full year.

guidance.statement: Expect 15-17% CAGR to continue for domestic MDF demand
guidance.quote: We expect 15% to 17% CAGR to continue for MDF.

guidance.statement: Target net asset turnover of 1.3x to 1.5x at full capacity
guidance.quote: I think we should be able to reach 1.3x to 1.5x number, I would say.

guidance.statement: Hope to achieve double-digit MDF EBITDA margins in upcoming quarters
guidance.quote: Well, that is definitely our aim and our hope, and we are hopeful that will happen, yes.

demand.statement: Retail MDF and plywood volume growth strong in Q2, building on Q1 momentum
demand.quote: On the retail front, volume growth remains strong both for MDF and plywood, building on the momentum of Q1.

demand.statement: OEM segment slow due to Q1 price increases and import substitution; recovery expected in H2
demand.quote: Price-sensitive OEM segment was slow to respond initially. Also, due to price increases taken in Q1, many OEMs had made alternate import arrangements, impact of which continued into Q2FY27.

demand.statement: Export order pipeline at start of October higher than Q2 sales; 85% exports to Middle East
demand.quote: Our opening export order pipeline as of start of October is higher versus the total sales made during Q2FY27.

margin.statement: Consolidated operating EBITDA margin 7.5% in Q2 FY27 vs 9.6% in Q1 FY27 and 10.2% last year
margin.quote: As a result of this, the consolidated operating EBITDA margin for the quarter was 7.5% versus 9.6% in Q1FY27 and 10.2% last year.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 operating EBITDA margin improved 100 bps to 8.4%
margin.quote: For the first half, operating EBITDA margin improved by 100 basis points to 8.4%.

margin.statement: Cost of production reduced 5% sequentially due to softening chemical costs; full impact not visible in Q2 due to expensive opening inventory
margin.quote: On the back of the softening of the chemical cost, our cost of production also reduced sequentially by 5%. However, considering that Q2FY27 still has the disadvantage of more expensive opening inventory from Q1FY27, the full impact of the reduced cost is yet not visible on the Q2FY27 result.

order_book.statement: Export order book at start of October: 13,000 cubic meters pending
order_book.quote: I had about 13,000 cubic meters of export orders that were pending.

pricing_cost.statement: Export FOB price for 18mm interior grade $200-220 per cubic meter
pricing_cost.quote: Let us say, basic product, 18 millimeter interior grade, today's market price would be anywhere between about $200 to $220 per cubic meter, FOB.

pricing_cost.statement: Raw material prices stabilized; industry moved away from eucalyptus dependency reducing price escalation
pricing_cost.quote: Raw materials we are noticing that it has stabilized over the past few months. And also the fact that the industry has moved on to different species of raw materials and moved away from the dependency on a singular species like eucalyptus, which has also resulted in sort of lesser price escalation of raw material in general.

product_mix.statement: Value-added products (HDHMR/HDWR/pre-lam) 43-44% of H1 volume, ~55% of value
product_mix.quote: For the first half, I remember this was 43%, 44% by volume. By value, this must have been close to 55%.

product_mix.statement: Focus on increasing retail and pre-lam sales to improve value mix
product_mix.quote: We have been focusing on increasing pre-lam sales.

risk.statement: Geopolitical situation in Middle East causing container/vessel shortages and higher delivery costs
risk.quote: Abnormal conditions in the Middle East continue to persist, impacting the availability of containers and vessels, leading to higher delivery costs for our end consumers.

risk.statement: Chemical cost volatility due to crude prices and geopolitical risks; hard to predict
risk.quote: Crude prices have again gone up. People are expecting the geopolitical situation to get disrupted again very soon. It is very hard to say where the chemical prices will stand at this point of time.

other.statement: Industry capacity additions of 800,000-900,000 cubic meters expected over next 2 years; pace moderating
other.quote: According to me, there would be an addition of about 800,000 to 900,000, which is over the next 2 years, cubic meters per year.

other.statement: Annual foreign trip with 150+ channel partners in Hong Kong/Macau strengthened relationships
other.quote: Our annual foreign trip scheme meet with our top 150-plus channel partners in Hong Kong and Macau in August has helped to further reinforce our connect with our partners.

guidance.statement: Fundraise expected by end of January or beginning of February 2027 after asset finalization
guidance.quote: We are very close to finalizing our targets, you know, and, fundraising is definitely going to be there by February, end of Jan, beginning of February of 2027.

guidance.statement: South Delhi hospital expected to operationalize in Q4 FY29-FY30
guidance.quote: And that's where we are. And, you know, the GRAP and all, so we are watching, you know, Delhi has a GRAP because of pollution. So, but we will be FY Q4, FY29-30 is when we are looking to operationalize it and we stand by that.

guidance.statement: Raipur hospital breakeven timeline maintained at 12 to 15 months
guidance.quote: So we have given you a breakeven timeline of 12 to 15 months. So, but internally, we will try to better it.

guidance.statement: Other income expected at similar Q2 levels for this year, diminishing slowly after Q4 next year
guidance.quote: So you can keep it as at a similar levels of what Q2 is, but after Q4 from the next year, it would be slowly diminishing but not at a single go.

demand.statement: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue INR 311 crores, up 13.2% YoY driven by cardiac sciences, oncology, neurosciences, orthopaedics, transplants
demand.quote: Our consolidated revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 was INR 311 crores, representing year-on-year growth of 13.2%. Growth was supported by demand across key specialties including cardiac sciences, oncology, neurosciences, orthopaedics and other complex treatments such as transplants.

demand.statement: International patients contributed approximately 30% of revenue in Q2, spread across 150+ countries
demand.quote: International patients contributed approximately 30% of the revenue during this quarter. A key development in our expansion plan is Artemis Shanti Hospital in Raipur, our 300-bed multi-specialty tertiary care hospital which began operations in July 2026.

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin 20.2% in Q2 FY27, adjusted operational EBITDA margin 23.3%
margin.quote: Our consolidated EBITDA for Q2 FY27 was INR 62.89 crores with a margin of 20.2%. While adjusted operational EBITDA for Q2 FY27 was INR 71.5 crores with a margin of 23.3%.

margin.statement: Room rent regulation (JPC) has zero impact as rates already at 3-star level
margin.quote: So the room tariffs, so we are already at par. We are only charging the 3-star rates because, you know, most of these are packages and our rates are already 3-stars. And I have given this statement to multiple channels and journalists, so that has zero impact for us.

margin.statement: Raipur hospital loss of INR 9 crores in Q2 on revenue of INR 5.3 crores, occupancy 10%, ARPOB 30,000-32,000
margin.quote: So, we have kind of estimated INR 9 crores to INR 10 crores of loss in the first quarter. Our loss stands at INR 9 crores. We had anticipated a top line of INR 4.3 crores. We have done INR5.3 crores, and our occupancy is 10% right now

product_mix.statement: Raipur hospital started with high-end surgeries (top-down approach) rather than routine cases, ARPOB 30,000-32,000 vs competitor 26,000-27,000
product_mix.quote: But the good news is our ARPOB is around 30,000 to 32,000. We had estimated the ARPOB as compared to our competitors at 26,000, 27,000, but we started with 32,000. So here I would like to say that we have some of the best quality doctors of Chhattisgarh in the hospital. And actually we have started top down. So we have started with more high-end surgeries rather than cough, cold, and fever.

fund_raise.statement: Board-approved fundraise actively progressing, asset finalization post-Diwali, raise expected end Jan - early Feb 2027
fund_raise.quote: We are very close to finalizing our targets, you know, and, fundraising is definitely going to be there by February, end of Jan, beginning of February of 2027. We are just waiting post-Diwali to finalize, the targets because, you know, we were very keen that all the compliances are met before we sign on the dotted line.

risk.statement: Oncology drug price regulation worst-case EBITDA impact 0.5-0.8%, broader drug regulation hypothetical impact up to 1-1.25%
risk.quote: So maybe from a 0.5 to 0.8, it could go up to, 1% or 1.25%. But again, this is very hypothetical, but it will not go more than that.

other.statement: Gurugram occupancy at 68% in Q2, targeting 75% occupancy
other.quote: And, we had a 68% occupancy, with this 23.8% EBITDA. We are confident of pushing it up to 75% occupancy

other.statement: Plan to increase operational capacity to around 2,000 beds over next 3 to 5 years via Raipur, Gurugram Tower 4, and South Delhi
other.quote: Along with Raipur and the Gurugram expansion, this facility supports our plan to increase our operational capacity to around 2,000 beds over the next 3 to 5 years.

guidance.statement: Revenue growth target of 55-60% YoY for FY27, aiming to cross INR 1,000 crores
guidance.quote: So as we just mentioned in Q2 also, so looking forward to have the revenue growth, with respect to last year about 55% to 60%, and which will cross INR 1,000 crores, which we believe so.

guidance.statement: Group EBITDA margin target of 15% once manufacturing setup is established
guidance.quote: As a group, we are looking forward by that time to have the EBITDA margin as a group level 15%, once my manufacturing setup is established here.

guidance.statement: Long-term revenue target of INR 5,000 crores over 5 years (roughly 7x FY26 revenue)
guidance.quote: Very recently you have outlined a INR 5,000 crores top-line target over the course of 5 years roughly, which would be around 7x of FY26 revenue.

margin.statement: NRE margin improvement driven by manufacturing and product solutions build-up
margin.quote: Driven by manufacturing and products solution which we are building up.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 14.5% vs 11% YoY; H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 14.2% vs 11.3% YoY
margin.quote: EBITDA margin for H1 FY27 stood at 14.2% versus 11.3% in H1 FY26.

margin.statement: KP Green solar EPC order (100 MW) targeting 8-10% EBITDA margin
margin.quote: Yes, we are working towards obtaining an EBITDA of somewhere around, 8% to 10% for the order.

order_book.statement: Consolidated order book including L1 positions at INR 1,575 crores as of Sep 30, 2026, up 47% YoY
order_book.quote: Our consolidated order book including the L1 positions stood at about INR 1,575 crores as on September 30th, 2026, reflecting year-on-year growth by 47%.

order_book.statement: Client mix: 60-65% public sector, 40% private sector; collection cycle equally efficient for both
order_book.quote: But broadly, this mix will be between 60%, 65% public and 40% private. And, looking to our history of last 3 to 4 years, our collection cycle in public has been equally efficient as with private.

order_book.statement: H1 FY27 executed orders worth INR 400 crores
order_book.quote: During this half year, we successfully, executed orders worth of INR 400 crores.

capex.statement: H1 FY27 capex incurred INR 101 crores; H2 FY27 planned capex INR 140 crores
capex.quote: In H1 we have done already, in my speech, INR 101 crores already incurred. And in H2, we are planning INR 140 crores investment further in FY27.

capex.statement: PTS manufacturing capex at full capacity can generate over INR 2,500 crores manufacturing sales
capex.quote: But broadly I can see the capex what we've been putting for the PTS side, if we run the plant in full capacity, we should be able to do the manufacturing sales of more than INR 2,500 crores.

pricing_cost.statement: Inflation impact managed through raw material booking and resource planning; expecting similar EBITDA margins for FY27
pricing_cost.quote: I think many parts of the inflation has been taken care in terms of booking the raw materials and our resources. So that's why I use the word that we're looking forward to have the similar kind of numbers for the year.

product_mix.statement: Current revenue mix: 60-62% EPC, 38% manufacturing; target 70-75% manufacturing by 2028-29
product_mix.quote: As per our new integrated manufacturing plan, our company is aiming to be 70% to 75% manufacturing, from the year 2028-29 based on the new facilities that are coming.

fund_raise.statement: Planning equity fund raise in Q3 or Q4 FY27 for working capital requirements
fund_raise.quote: And yes, we are also -- as we discussed last time, we are in process to raise, some funds, maybe in Q3 or Q4, wherein, we'll be having some equity as a working capital requirement for the company.

risk.statement: Sector dependent on macroeconomic factors beyond company control; capital allocation and cash flow sensitivity emphasized
risk.quote: You are rightly aware -- you are well aware that this sector is definitely depend on a lot of macroeconomic factors which is beyond the control of the particular industry. So, that that will also affect.

other.statement: 2.5 GWh BESS manufacturing facility (expandable to 5 GWh) expected operational by Q4 FY27
other.quote: For our 2.5 GWh BESS manufacturing facility, which can be expandable up to 5 GWh, We have placed the final plant and machinery orders, and the plant is expected to be operational by Q4 financial year '27.

other.statement: BESS plant first year capacity utilization expected at 40-60%
other.quote: And, for the capacity utilization, we are looking forward for anywhere about 40% to 60% capacity utilization for the first year of the plant capacity.

guidance.statement: Full-year pre-sales guidance maintained at INR 24,000 crores with H2 mix of INR 6,000-7,000 crores DevCo pre-sales per quarter plus INR 1,500 crores data center land sale in Q4
guidance.quote: The numbers for the second half of the year are likely to be coming with a mix of about INR 6000 crores to INR 7,000 crores of development company pre-sales in both Q3 as well as Q4 and 1 data center land transaction of about INR 1,500 crores in the fourth quarter for the full year number at about INR 24,000 crores of pre-sales.

guidance.statement: Full-year operating cash flow expected around INR 85 billion
guidance.quote: In the second half, we expect that our operating cash flow as it was in last fiscal, will significantly crank up, and we expect full year that our operating cash flow will be put around INR 85 billion or thereabouts.

guidance.statement: DevCo to become net debt-free over next 2-3 years in line with previous guidance
guidance.quote: And therefore, will support an improvement in our return on equity further and will also aid our DevCo to become net debt-free over the next 2 to 3 years, which is in line with our previous guidance.

guidance.statement: Definitive documents for first BTS data center box expected this fiscal, construction start this fiscal, delivery and rental earnings from FY29
guidance.quote: We expect to have the definitive documents executed for the first BTS box of in this fiscal year and to start construction for the boxes also in this fiscal year with a view to delivering those boxes to the end tenant in fiscal '29, and therefore, starting the rental earnings from our data center BTS program in fiscal '29 itself.

demand.statement: Bangalore market absorption INR 52,500 crores in H1 FY27 (up 10% YoY), premium segment (>INR 2Cr) now 50% of market
demand.quote: The market continues to remain robust in FY '27 with the first half of this year, recording an absorption of about INR 52,500 crores, up 10% over the same period of last year.

demand.statement: Market momentum strong in October festive season; segments served (INR 1-5Cr and >INR 5Cr) not affected by rate hikes
demand.quote: We expect that the momentum in the market will continue through this year, and this is in spite of the fact that the adverse effects, if any, of the rising interest rates have already started. Having said that, we believe that the segments that we serve are not really affected by the change in interest rates.

demand.statement: NRI demand from Gulf (4-5% of sales, entry-level INR 1-3Cr) only segment impacted by Middle East war
demand.quote: In terms of the impact on the footfall from the Gulf wa r, as I mentioned in my opening remarks, the only impact we've seen so far in terms of sales is from the NRI sales in the Middle East, which make up about 4% to 5% of our sales. And these tend to be more focused entry level, which are homes between INR 1 crores to INR 3 crores

margin.statement: YTD price growth ~4%, cost growth ~4% annually, disciplined pricing adding 100-200 bps to margin yearly
margin.quote: So, we believe that just doing this with discipline, price growth around 6%, cost growth around 4%, is adding 100, 150, 200 basis points to margin each year, which really is helpful.

margin.statement: Q2 embedded EBITDA and PAT reflect underlying development business profitability with no land sales
margin.quote: Speaking of profitability, I would like to point out that the numbers that you see for Q2 are really the underlying profitability of our solid development business because there were no land sales in this quarter.

order_book.statement: Bangalore FY27 pre-sales likely to cross INR 3,000 crores with 6 operating projects by year-end
order_book.quote: With this, we would h ave six operating projects by the end of FY 27 and we are likely to cross about INR 3,000 crores in pre-sales from Bangalore in this financial year

capex.statement: H2 FY27 launches just under INR 20,000 crores GDV planned across geographies
capex.quote: In the second half of the year, we have a further almost just under INR 20,000 crores of new launches planned. And while 1 or 2 launches may move by a month or 2, overall, the program is a very solid and dispersed across different geographies.

capex.statement: Data center campus power availability increased to 5 GW (4 GW IT output) with $150B+ investment potential
capex.quote: It's important to note that with this campus of about 5 gigawatts of input power, which will translate into a little over 4 gigawatts of IT output. The level of investment that India will get will be in the range of $150 billion or more.

capex.statement: Construction spend expected to pick up further in H2 after monsoon slowdown in Q2
capex.quote: We would expect to further pick up construction spend because the first half of the quarter, especially the second quarter monsoon period is slower. So, we would expect a further pickup in construction spend, all other things being equal.

pricing_cost.statement: Data center land transaction in Q4 likely at high 50s crores per acre vs last at INR 42 crores/acre
pricing_cost.quote: The current transaction is likely to be at a significantly higher from price compar ed to the last transaction, which happened at INR 42 crores per acre, and it will be in the ballpark of high 50s or

pricing_cost.statement: BTS rental guidance unchanged at INR 20-23 billion per GW, but considered conservative with upside expected
pricing_cost.quote: In terms of the rental from the BTS box of about INR 20 billion per annum - we do think that, that number is a conservative estimate, and we expect that number to move up over time. But right now, there is no change in our guidance with respect to the quantum of rentals.

other.statement: MMR launch pipeline INR 100B GDV, ~INR 40B from South-Central Mumbai
other.quote: In terms of the launch pipeline, we have about INR 100 billion GDV in the MMR of which about South-Central Mumbai launches will be approximately INR 40 billion.

other.statement: H1 collections INR 76B (up 19% YoY), operating cash flow INR 27B; Q2 collections INR 35B
other.quote: In terms of our collections and cash flows. The first half collections were at about INR 76 billion, up 19% year-on-year, and the operating cash flow was about INR 27 billion. Q2 collections were about INR 35 billion following the usual pattern.

guidance.statement: HALS capacity utilization expected to reach 55-60% in coming quarters
guidance.quote: And I think going forward, we expect that the coming few quarters, we should touch between 55% to 60% capacity utilization.

guidance.statement: Performance Chemical 2 target 20-25% capacity utilization in first year
guidance.quote: But of course, the target is to touch 20%, 25% capacity utilization in the first year.

guidance.statement: New HALS product 2020 plant (1,000 ton line) to start by April or May
guidance.quote: Say, for instance, a product like 2020. We did a lot of trials. We did some commercial trials on plant. And now we believe we have to put up a 1,000 ton line, and we will do so and the plant should start by April or May.

guidance.statement: Performance Chemical 2 commercial production targeted for Q4 FY27 (Jan-Feb)
guidance.quote: So the Performance Chemical 2, the deadline, I mean we are hoping really to start the commercial production in Q4, so probably in the month of Jan, Feb.

demand.statement: Base business: resilient volume-led growth across Performance and Pharma; export sales 73% vs 64% previous quarter
demand.quote: On the base business of Clean Science, the base business saw a resilient volume-led growth across Performance and Pharma segment. Export sales increased to 73% of the stand-alone business against 64% during the previous quarter.

demand.statement: Customer demand remained resilient despite high input costs
demand.quote: However, the customer demand remained resilient.

margin.statement: Standalone Q2 EBITDA margin 36%, PAT margin 24%; raw material cost rose to 41% from 35% in Q1
margin.quote: EBITDA and PAT margins are at 36% and 24%, translating into EBITDA of INR82 crores and PAT of INR55 crores. Margin moderation was primarily due to high raw material costs, which rose to 41% from 35% in Q1 FY27.

margin.statement: Backward integration of HALS precursors expected to improve margins by 5-7% for those products
margin.quote: So there could be between 5%, 7% improvement in margins for those particular segment of HALS.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 12% on consolidated basis; Q2 standalone EBITDA margin 36%
margin.quote: Healthy volumes, continuous process improvement and benefits of operational leverage have resulted in EBITDA margin of 12% in the first half of FY27.

capex.statement: Capital infusion in subsidiary INR50 crores in Q2 FY27 and INR150 crores in H1 FY27
capex.quote: During the quarter, capital infusion in subsidiary was approximately INR50 crores and INR150 crores in H1 FY27.

capex.statement: Total investment in subsidiary stands at INR900 crores
capex.quote: With this, the total investment in subsidiary company stands at INR900 crores.

capex.statement: Performance Chemical 2 to be commercialized by Q3-Q4 FY27
capex.quote: Performance Chemical 2 will get commercialized by quarter 3 to quarter 4 FY27.

pricing_cost.statement: Key raw materials (phenol, acetone, methanol) 50-100% higher YoY; coal and freight costs also up
pricing_cost.quote: Key raw materials such as phenol, acetone and methanol were 50% to 100% higher year-on-year alongside an increase in coal and freight costs.

pricing_cost.statement: Unable to pass through raw material cost increases due to lower Chinese prices
pricing_cost.quote: With Chinese prices yet to move up, the pass-through to the customers was difficult.

product_mix.statement: HALS portfolio mix: 60% 770 grade, 40% advanced HALS; ratio shifting toward advanced grades
product_mix.quote: 60% is still 770 and 40% is now the advanced HALS. And I think this ratio will keep changing as we move quarter-on-quarter basis.

product_mix.statement: HALS revenue 2x YoY; H1 FY27 volumes 67% of full FY26 volumes
product_mix.quote: On the HALS segment, on Y-o-Y basis, the HALS segment grew 2x in revenue during the quarter. It was achieved on back of robust HALS volume growth. To give a little perspective, in H1 FY27, we achieved aggregated volumes of 67% of the total volumes achieved during entire previous financial

risk.statement: Barbituric acid project on hold due to uncompetitive economics vs Chinese pricing
risk.quote: See, basically, we realized that currently, the prices which Chinese are offering, we are not able to offer those prices. So we have kept this product on hold for the moment.

other.statement: HALS capacity currently 11,500 tons; to reach 12,500 tons with advanced grade additions
other.quote: HALS capacity as of now is close to 11,500 tons. With this NOR Collaboration Association, we would like to add incremental capacity only in the advanced grade of HALS. So that will take out our overall capacity to close to 12,500 tons.

other.statement: Hydroquinone/catechol at 30-35% capacity utilization, used for captive consumption
other.quote: So in hydroquinone, catechol -- Sanjesh, see, right now, we are at about 30%, 35% capacity utilization. And fortunately, all these capacities are currently used for our own captive consumption.

guidance.statement: Full-year net new store additions guidance of 200-220 stores
guidance.quote: We are on track to meet our full-year guidance of 200 to 220 net new additions with the same discipline, the right locations and a clear line of sight to profitability.

guidance.statement: Merger with Sapphire Foods expected to close by end of current financial year
guidance.quote: In summary, we continue to remain optimistic about closing the merger process by the end of the current financial year.

guidance.statement: KFC India store additions guidance of 100-110 stores for current year
guidance.quote: We talked about 100 to 110 stor es for Devyani for KFC for the current year. We will be able to deliver on that

demand.statement: Positive SSSG of 4-9% across brand portfolio in India except Pizza Hut
demand.quote: We have had a good quarter with positive SSSGs ranging from 4% to 9% across our brand portfolio in India, except Pizza Hut, which also saw sequentially better numbers.

demand.statement: KFC SSSG at 4.4% with on-premise saliency of 56%
demand.quote: At KFC, SSSG came in at 4.4% with on-premise saliency of 56%.

demand.statement: Pizza Hut SSSG decline narrowed to -1.4% with ADS at INR 32,000 per store per day
demand.quote: At Pizza Hut, SSSG decline narrowed versus the previous quarter at minus 1.4%, with ADS at INR 32,000 per store per day.

margin.statement: Consolidated operating EBITDA margin improved to 8.2% from 6.8% YoY
margin.quote: Together with effective management of G&A costs, this helped us post operating EBITDA margin of 8.2% versus 6.8% in the previous year.

margin.statement: Brand contribution margin expanded to 13% with brand contribution of INR 198 crore, up 23% YoY
margin.quote: The consolidated brand contribution margin expanded to 13% with a brand contribution of INR 198 crore, up 23% year-on-year.

margin.statement: KFC brand contribution margin flat at 13.9% despite wage and LPG cost increases
margin.quote: Brand contribution margin came in at 13.9%, virtually flat versus the previous year despite steep minimum wage increases, especially in states like Karnataka, Kerala, Andhra and Telangana and elevated LPG prices.

pricing_cost.statement: Took 1-2% price hike YTD on staggered basis to protect consumer sentiment
