pricing_cost.quote: We have taken a very small and calibrated 1% to 2% price hike on a YTD basis, and we continue to monitor the movement of key raw materials. Our endeavour is to take price hikes on a staggered basis to protect the already muted consumer sentiment.

risk.statement: Food and fuel inflation, job losses from AI adoption pressuring household budgets; discretionary spending under pressure
risk.quote: We have seen strong food and fuel infla tion and job losses because of AI adoption. The household budgets are under pressure. With this, we also need to reorient ourselves more in favor of value, given the macroeconomic reality in the Country and a strong K-shaped economy that India is turning into

other.statement: KFC network reached 844 stores with 50 net new additions
other.quote: We added 50 net new stores, taking the KFC network to 844 stores.

other.statement: Pizza Hut network at 632 stores with 6 net new additions replacing underperforming stores
other.quote: We ended the quarter with 632 stores, adding 6 net new stores to replace underperforming stores that we have closed.

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue guidance revised to around INR 600 crores from earlier INR 650 crores due to project deferment
guidance.quote: Out of INR 650 crores top line, a little drop would be there because earlier, in the beginning, we thought our new project MCC 12,000 metric tons capacity will come a little early, but some deferment would be there. Now, more or less, around INR 600 or so we can reach.

guidance.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin guidance maintained at around 18% for full year, with H2 expected to be at least 18% or better
guidance.quote: The overall guidance also we have given around 18%, but second half, at least, we are expecting even better, at least 18%, even better than 18%, so that it will balance out.

guidance.statement: FY28 revenue expected to exceed INR 800 crores with new MCC capacity adding over INR 200 crores top line
guidance.quote: Next year, this 12,000 metric tons capacity is expected in Q2 end. Maybe one or two months here and there would be there. After that, 12,000 metric tons into INR 250, 12,000 into 90%, its operational also around 10,800 metric tons into INR 225, if you take both, there is almost more than INR 200 crores top line will come, INR 243 crores.

demand.statement: Demand for MCC and CCS very high; orders exceed production capacity; supply is the only constraint
demand.quote: But always for us, ther e is a good demand, and Sigachi is known for quality and customer satisfaction, means timely supply of the materials, and then also addressing their pain points in the operational, flow of material in capsulation or tableting, and all those things, we neve r faced. We have high demand, right now, the supply is the only constraint

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 14.72%; H2 margins expected to improve on higher special/co-processed grade mix and fixed cost absorption
margin.quote: We are expecting because in the second half, there will not be further increase in fixed overhead costs. There will be increase in revenue, and the margins also will be on higher side. And sales mix also is going to change. The co-processed variants and then special grades will be on higher side in the next six months.

order_book.statement: API order book expected to reach INR 100-120 crores in FY27 with H1 at INR 38 crores and strong Q3-Q4 expected
order_book.quote: Order book, see, half year, we have reached INR 38 crores, and next third quarter and fourth quarter would be good, and so nearly INR 100 crores we can reach. Even now, if there is a good order in fourth quarter, then we can reach another INR 10 or 20 crores also, up to INR 120 crores also, is a possibility in API.

capex.statement: INR 29 crores spent so far on combined MCC and CCS projects at Dahej SEZ
capex.quote: Total all put together is around INR 30 crores, nearly INR 29 crores.

capex.statement: Total CapEx for 12,000 MTPA MCC expansion and CCS facility at Dahej estimated at roughly INR 200 crores (INR 100 crores MCC, INR 90 crores CCS)
capex.quote: Around INR 100 crores for MCC and around INR 90 crores for CCS. Maybe for the total CapEx, that would be roughly INR 200 crores.

pricing_cost.statement: MCC average realization improved from INR 216.42/kg in H1 FY26 to INR 252.16/kg in H1 FY27; Q2 realization INR 262.83/kg vs Q1 INR 241.36/kg
pricing_cost.quote: Gradually, it is improving. Even the margins average price realization, if you see, in Q1 it is 241.36, and Q2, it is 262.83. And then an average for the entire H1, it is 252.16, whereas previous year, H1, it was 216.42.

product_mix.statement: Special and co-processed MCC grades currently ~20% of mix, targeting 50% increase in Q3-Q4 to drive higher revenue and margins
product_mix.quote: Now, within Q3 and Q4, almost, it is 50% increase would be there to the existing. Existing is around 20%. And there is much increase we are seeing in Q3 and Q4. That is the reason we are expecting higher revenues as well as the margins.

risk.statement: Lower capacity utilization in H1 due to safety audits and equipment installation post Hyderabad plant accident; safety prioritized over production
risk.quote: The thing is, after Hyderabad plant accident, we have concentrated more on safety audits, internal, external, and customer audits more on this. That's why when the concentration is on this, the production concentration was less. The main intention is the safety. Safety is the first priority.

other.statement: 12,000 MTPA MCC expansion and CCS facility at Dahej SEZ expected to commission in Q2 FY28, taking total MCC capacity to ~30,000 MTPA
other.quote: 12,000 metric tonne-per-annum of MCC expansion of Dahej SEZ is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY28, taking a total MCC capacity to approximately 30,000 metric ton-per-annum.

other.statement: Current MCC capacity utilization ~80% at Dahej and Jhagadia; expected to increase by 10% after safety equipment installation by Nov 15-20
other.quote: In the half year, there is almost 79.91%, around 80% in the Dahej unit, and the Jhagadia unit around 79%. Overall, nearly 80% utilization is there. Another 10% there will be increase from another 15 days, from 15th to 20th of November.

guidance.statement: Express volume growth for FY27 expected at upper end of 20-30% range, potentially beyond
guidance.quote: as things stand, I don't really see any reason for us to revise our estimate of growth. In fact, we are at the moment, beyond the upper end of the 20-30% that we had guided at the start of the year.

guidance.statement: Express service EBITDA margin for FY27 expected around 17%
guidance.quote: I think it's safe to say that FY27, 17% sounds absolutely where we will end up.

guidance.statement: Aggregated transportation margins to expand 130-150 bps YoY in FY27
guidance.quote: Our estimation is that overall aggregated transportation margins should expand by 130-150 basis points even conservatively between FY26 and FY27.

guidance.statement: E-commerce volume growth guidance of 15-20% for FY27 remains reasonable
guidance.quote: I don't see any particular reason for our guidance on e-commerce in general growing volume terms somewhere between 15-20% being, very, very off.

demand.statement: Express market expected to grow 15-20% volume CAGR medium term; Delhivery aims to grow at minimum that rate while gaining share via network quality and tech investments.
demand.quote: we think will continue to grow at that 15-20% kind of range that we have said in the past in volume terms. That is one we definitely in any case, our belief is that we should continue to grow at a minimum of that if not higher as we continue to gain share.

demand.statement: October volumes slightly ahead of forecast despite macro volatility
demand.quote: the month of October has also been a pretty good month for us. And we're ahead of where we actually expected to be as of this month.

margin.statement: PTL margins to expand YoY in FY27
margin.quote: PTL margins should expand between FY26 and FY27.

margin.statement: Express margins at least equal to FY26 levels, with potential upside from PTL volume growth
margin.quote: Express, it should be at least equal to FY26 levels, let me put it that way.

order_book.statement: Supply chain services pipeline remains robust; two new Q1 businesses stabilised and expanding; e-commerce starts up 50%+ YoY; enterprise side conservative due to cost unpredictability.
order_book.quote: Our ecommerce starts within supply chain services have actually gained pace that business is up, I think, probably 50% plus, YoY.

capex.statement: Investing in automation (AGVs, robotics) and AI initiatives; 40% stake in Falcon Autotech gives cost curve visibility
capex.quote: we are also 40% shareholders in Falcon Autotech, we understand how the cost curve for automation works. And we do believe we're at that cost in terms of new robotic systems that we otherwise would simply have been unable to deploy maybe three or four years ago.

pricing_cost.statement: Less than 30% of PTL yield increase came from cost-linked price revisions; majority from yield improvements.
pricing_cost.quote: The answer is that less than 30% of the increase in yield, for example, in PTL has come as a consequence of underlying cost inflation linked price revision.

pricing_cost.statement: Price revisions started mid-to-late Q1, fructified in Q2 across Express and PTL
pricing_cost.quote: we started making them towards the middle end of Q1. We had spoken about this in Q1 that a lot of them would fructify in Q2 and you can see that has taken place across both the Express and the PTL businesses.

product_mix.statement: Delhivery Local ARR crossed Rs 200 Cr, targeting Rs 240-250 Cr by FY27 exit, CM breakeven possible in Q4 FY27
product_mix.quote: Our aim was to really get to maybe Rs. 240-250 Cr ARR by exit of this financial year. As things stand, we've already crossed Rs. 200 Cr and are growing faster than we originally expected.

product_mix.statement: International Saver business at ~Rs 140 Cr ARR, grew 55% QoQ Q1 to Q2 FY27, service EBITDA breakeven
product_mix.quote: The Saver business that we had launched, are today hitting probably close to Rs. 140 Cr ARR in this business. It's actually grown 55% QoQ between Q1FY27 and Q2FY27 and has also broken even at a service EBITDA level.

risk.statement: US midterm elections and fuel price volatility cited as near-term macro risks
risk.quote: frankly, US midterm elections are on Tuesday. So, let's see how things go.

risk.statement: Fuel price hike pass-through lag will be significantly smaller going forward as contracts revised; no crystal ball on future diesel prices.
risk.quote: our contracts are revised now to make sure that the lag effect is significantly smaller.

other.statement: Express shipments 325 million in Q2 FY27, up 32% YoY
other.quote: Our express business delivered 325 million shipments in Q2FY27. So, we are up about 32% YoY.

other.statement: PTL freight 545K metric tonnes in Q2 FY27, up 14.2% YoY
other.quote: The PTL business delivered 545K metric tonnes of freight, up about 14.2% YoY.

guidance.statement: Expect cost growth to return to low single digits within next one to two quarters after one-time step-up
guidance.quote: Once they are in place - which we expect within the next one to two quarters - we expect subsequent cost growth to return to our historical levels, which have been in the low single digits.

guidance.statement: Expect FY27 to show impact of investments in improved growth rates and expanded market share
guidance.quote: Overall, we have a strong set of growth initiatives in place, and we expect financial year FY27 to start showing the impact of these investments, both in terms of improved growth rates and expanded market share across our key segments.

demand.statement: Global tech funding for 2026 on track to be highest in decade driven by mega AI rounds
demand.quote: Total dollars invested in the private markets are rising - global tech funding for 2026 is on track to become the highest in the decade, driven primarily by mega AI rounds.

demand.statement: Deal volume at 10-year low both in India and internationally
demand.quote: Deal volume, however, is at a 10-year low, both in India and internationally.

demand.statement: Global M&A rebound stronger, 2026 could be second-highest year after 2021 peak
demand.quote: On global M&A, the rebound is much stronger: 2026 continues with very good momentum, and the current run-rate suggests this year could become the second-highest year after the 2021 peak, both in terms of global M&A deal value and IB advisory fees.

margin.statement: No margin expansion in Q2 due to growth investments; historically convert up to 80% of incremental revenue to incremental EBITDA
margin.quote: Q2 we did not see margin expansion because we are investing in growth. But historically, as Tracxn Technologies Limited – Q2 FY27 Earnings Call Transcript 2 soon as growth accelerates, margins improve quickly - we have converted as high as 80% of incremental revenue into incremental EBITDA

order_book.statement: Deferred revenue at end of Q2 FY27 was 38.1 crore, up 9% year-on-year
order_book.quote: Deferred revenue at the end of Q2 FY27 was 38.1 crore, a 9% year-on-year increase.

capex.statement: Completed most of sales team expansion, onboarded nearly 56 of 60 planned closing-sales members by September 2026
capex.quote: We are pleased to share that we completed most of this expansion as of September 2026 - we have onboarded nearly 56 of the 60 planned closing-sales team members.

pricing_cost.statement: India ASP about half of international geographies
pricing_cost.quote: A lot of the growth also happened in India, where the ASP is about half of what it is in international geographies.

product_mix.statement: Launched Tracxn MCP for AI tools listed on Claude and ChatGPT marketplaces, AI Assistant on platform, and agentic workflows combining in-house data with Tracxn data
product_mix.quote: The Tracxn MCP is now listed on the Claude and ChatGPT marketplaces, and it also works with tools like Gemini and Cursor; we've also enabled faster responses and lower token consumption.

product_mix.statement: Launched coverage of stealth companies, Talent Signals, estimated revenues for private companies, valuations of historical M&A deals, expanded headcount data to 3.4M entities, UK private-company financials to 5.2M entities (16x since March
product_mix.quote: One that recently went live is our coverage of stealth companies - something clients had been consistently asking for, to source early-stage deals before their public launch - and this is already showing good early results.

risk.statement: One-time cost step-up from investments in data and sales across international business units; expect cost growth to normalize in 1-2 quarters
risk.quote: These investments have also led to a one-time cost step-up. Once they are in place - which we expect within the next one to two quarters - we expect subsequent cost growth to return to our historical levels, which have been in the low single digits.

other.statement: Sales and marketing now nearly 30% of total headcount, up from 25% same quarter last year
other.quote: Sales and marketing today account for nearly 30% of total headcount, up from 25% in the same quarter last year - a meaningful shift towards sales-led growth.

other.statement: 48% of H1 FY27 revenue from outside India; customers in over 50 countries
other.quote: In terms of geographical split, 48% of H1 FY27 revenue was from outside India. We have customers spanning over 50 countries, and our top five markets by customer accounts are India, US, UK, Singapore and Germany.

guidance.statement: Targets quarterly revenue run-rate of Rs 70-80 crore; realistic timeline Q4 FY27 if geopolitical situation stabilizes
guidance.quote: But I mean, if we talk about more realistic terms, then let's put it as Q4.

margin.statement: Q2 EBITDA margin 2.17% vs 12.69% in Q1 FY27 and -6.65% in Q2 FY26; H1 EBITDA margin 7.66% vs 3.42% in H1 FY26 (+424 bps)
margin.quote: EBITDA stood at Rs. 1.3 crores compared with an EBITDA loss of Rs. 3.6 crores in the corresponding quarter last year. The EBITDA margin was 2.17% compared with a negative margin of 6.65% in Q2 FY’26 and 12.69% in Q1 FY’27.

pricing_cost.statement: Unable to pass on most cost increases to customers; absorbed majority of cost; passed on only certain freight cost via FOB terms
pricing_cost.quote: See, overall if you see the pricing, we have not been able to pass on much of the cost to the customer. Most of the cost at this point of time is already being absorbed by the company.

product_mix.statement: Marquartz selling price 20%-30% higher than regular products; expects volumes to grow further; domestic launch ~70% from India factory, 30%-35% from UAE
product_mix.quote: The average selling price of marquartz from a regular product category, it is, the selling price is up by about 20 % to 30 %.

fund_raise.statement: Board approved conversion of AED 3M (USD 10.86M ~Rs 110.44 cr) unsecured loan to Global Surfaces FZE into equity on 10 Aug 2026; reclassified as advance towards equity subscription pending ODI/FEMA filings
fund_raise.quote: The B oard on the recommendation of the Audit Committee approved the conversion on 10th August, AED 3 million USD10.86 million aggregating and equivalent to approximately Rs. 110.44 crores

risk.statement: Near-term operating environment challenging due to US trade measures uncertainty and regional geopolitical situations inflating input and trade costs
risk.quote: Looking ahead, the near -term operating environment is expected to remain challenging particularly given the uncertainty around the U.S. trade measures and regional geopolitical situations related to inflated input and trade costs.

other.statement: ~70%-75% of H1 operating cash flow came from higher payables (approximate)
other.quote: I believe about 70%-75% H1 revenue came from higher payables.

other.statement: Raw material prices up 25%-50% translating to ~10% average selling price impact; freight cost on imported raw materials increased nearly 5x
other.quote: Prices of certain raw materials increased by 25% to 50% translating into estimated average impact of around 10 % on selling prices. In addition, the freight cost on imported raw materials increased nearly 5 folds.

guidance.statement: Expects H2 FY27 EBITDA margin around 15% despite Q3 impact from HPHT allocation changes
guidance.quote: Having said that, we remain confident of maintaining an EBITDA margin of around 15% for H2.

guidance.statement: Volume growth may moderate slightly from earlier 12% target but profit contribution will exceed expectations
guidance.quote: As of now, we don't expect this to surpass what we said to you earlier. There may be some slight moderation in the volume, but profit side, it will be a good contribution beyond your expectation.

demand.statement: Q2 FY27 volume reached all-time high of 61.23 MMSCM, up 12% YoY
demand.quote: During Q2 FY27, total sales volume reached all-time high to 61.23 MMSCM, up by 12% YoY.

demand.statement: Namakkal & Trichy volume share increased from 6% in FY26 to 11% in H1 FY27
demand.quote: This contribution from Namakkal & Trichy has increased from approximately 6% from the total volume in FY26 to 11% now in this H1 FY27.

demand.statement: H1 FY27 total sales volume grew 10% YoY to 120.16 MMSCM; CNG up 23%, commercial PNG up 61%
demand.quote: H1 FY27 volume grew by 10% to 120.16 MMSCM. Growth was primarily driven by CNG and commercial PNG, which grew 23% and 61% respectively, during H1FY27

margin.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded 646 bps YoY to 16.5%
margin.quote: The EBITDA margin expanded by 646 basis points to 16.5%.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded 388 bps YoY to 14.2%
margin.quote: EBITDA margins also expanded by 388 basis points to 14.2%.

margin.statement: EBITDA per SCM increased to INR 7.73 in Q2 FY27 from INR 4.89 in Q2 FY26
margin.quote: EBITDA per S CM increased to 7.73 from 4.89 in Q2 FY26.

capex.statement: INR 137.08 crore of IPO proceeds remain for Namakkal & Trichy network development
capex.quote: An amount of approximately INR 137.08 crores remains to be utilized towards the development of the Namakkal and Tiruchirappalli network.

capex.statement: FY27 capex plan of INR 250-260 crore on track; INR 111 crore spent in H1 (INR 54 crore Q1, INR 57 crore Q2)
capex.quote: Overall company has taken up INR 250-260 crores to be spent in this financial year. And we are already progressing well as planned. We may even surpass this plan, but we assure you that this is on track and will be met through.

pricing_cost.statement: Gas sourcing mix in Q2: APM 21%, new well 13%, HPHT 33%, LNG 30%, spot 1-2%
pricing_cost.quote: In Q2, approximately, APM on the portfolio basis is around 21%. The new well gas is around 13%. HPHT, we have taken around 33% on the overall portfolio basis. LNG, is around 30%, and remaining 1-2% is on the spot basis.

pricing_cost.statement: Gas costs: APM capped at USD 7/MMBtu, new well USD 10.2, HPHT USD 8.9, RLNG USD 11-12; blended average ~USD 9.5
pricing_cost.quote: APM is capped at USD 7. So, we are availing on the same cap at the USD 7 MMBtu. There's new well gas, NWG also, again, linked to this A PM. So, we have do ne at around USD 10.2. This H PHT is again , it is a subsidized cost available into the market, public data available. This is around USD 8.9. And LNG or RLNG is between USD 11-12 MMBtu.

fund_raise.statement: IPO proceeds INR 496 crore received; INR 358.68 crore utilized (INR 170.18 cr NT network, INR 135 cr debt repayment, INR 53.5 cr GCP)
fund_raise.quote: With respect to the IPO proceeds, INR 496 crore was received against the stated object of the issue. As of September 30, 2026, INR 358.68 crore had been utilized, including INR 170.18 crore towards the development of the city gas distribution network in the NT area, INR 135 crore towards the repayment of the borrowing, and INR 53.50 crore towards general corporate purpose.

risk.statement: Geopolitical uncertainty in West Asia and Brent volatility may impact H2; Q3 impacted by HPHT transition
risk.quote: Given the evolving regulatory environment and continued geopolitical uncertainty in West Asia, we also can't remain fully immune, but we expect the operating environment to remain, a little uncertain during H2 FY27 also.

other.statement: Income tax paid net of refund INR 4.5 crore in H1 (INR 12.5 crore paid, refund received)
other.quote: So, we have paid around INR 12.5 crore in this quarter. So , this INR 4.5 crore is a net of the refund only, because we also got some refund from the previous year as well. So, this is the net.

other.statement: Interest cost ~7-8% on INR 45 crore debt; bank guarantee charges 0.5-0.6% also in finance cost
other.quote: The one is the INR 45 crore interest cost, which is around 7-8%, and another one is the bank guarantee. So, we are also having multiple bank guarantees, which we had given for the PNGRB. We are also going to taking permission and all for the local authority. So, that bank guarantee is within the range of 0.5-0.6%.

guidance.statement: Loan book target of over INR16,000 crores and 300+ branches by FY29
guidance.quote: We continue to target a loan book of over INR16,000 crores-plus and a network of more than 300 branches by FY29.

guidance.statement: FY27 loan growth guidance of 20-22% with positive bias given H1 at 23%
guidance.quote: Current year, in the beginning of the year, we've given a guidance of 20% to 22%, and we are talking H1 and 23%.

guidance.statement: ROA target 1.6% by FY29 from 1.39% currently driven by NIM and opex
guidance.quote: Our next growth journey in ROA, which is 1.39% to 1.6% is based typically on 2 figures. That is the NIM and opex.

guidance.statement: Target 30%+ branches outside Punjab by FY29 from 21% currently
guidance.quote: As part of our Vision 2029, we are targeting that we need to have 30% plus branches outside the state of Punjab.

demand.statement: Disbursements up 36% YoY to INR1,095 crores in Q2 FY27 indicating healthy demand
demand.quote: Disbursements stayed strong throughout the quarter and stood at INR1,095 crores, up 36% year-on-year.

demand.statement: Out-of-Punjab advances grew 39% YoY vs overall 23% showing strong demand in new geographies
demand.quote: Advances there grew by over 39% year-on-year this quarter, comfortably ahead of our overall loan growth of 23%.

margin.statement: NIM improved to 4.24% in Q2 FY27 from 4.04% YoY and 4.21% QoQ
margin.quote: Our net interest margin held steady at 4.24% against 4.04% a year back in a quarter where the rate environment actually turned.

margin.statement: 52% fixed rate advances, 48% floating; EBR-linked portfolio 13-14% reprices monthly
margin.quote: If we talk about the balance sheet, we have around 52% fixed rate advances and 48% floating rate advances. So we can say around 50 -50 each. So 50-50 each is typically fixed and floating. And if I talk about the flo ating, floating is a fair balance of the MCLR linked as well as the linked with the EBR. So EBR-linked portfolio will be typically around 13% to 14% of the portfolio is EBR linked

margin.statement: Yield on advances stable at 11% YoY; cost of deposits fell 24 bps YoY to 5.68%
margin.quote: Yield on advances for Q2 FY27 remain at 11% against 11% last year Q2. So we have seen a repo rate hike in October, so the benefit of that has not been pulled into the yield on advances in Q2.

order_book.statement: Gross advances INR9,755 crores, up 23.4% YoY and 7.5% QoQ as of Sep 30, 2026
order_book.quote: Our gross advances stood at INR9,755 crores as of September 30, '26, up 23.4% year-on-year, and 7.5% over the previous quarter.

order_book.statement: Business loans now 28% of book vs 23% YoY; Mortgage 24%, Agriculture 26%, Corporate 14%
order_book.quote: As of September 30, our portfolio continues to remain well diversified and Business Loan segment is presently the largest segment, which increased to 28% of the book against 23% a year back.

capex.statement: Out-of-Punjab branches at INR80 cr+ business per branch for 5+ year vintage vs INR72 cr
capex.quote: Business per branch in these markets, that is the out of Punjab market are continuing to show upward trajectory with business per branch has started hitting INR80 crores plus for branches with a longevity of 5 years and above, against INR72 crores at the end of

capex.statement: 222 branches across 5 states and 2 UTs; 47 branches (21%) outside Punjab
capex.quote: As of September, our network stood at 222 branches across 5 states and 2 union territory, strengthening our footprints in rural and semi-urban markets.

pricing_cost.statement: Cost-to-income 59.8% vs 61.7% YoY; operating leverage benefits expected
pricing_cost.quote: On efficiency, our cost-to-income ratio is 59.8%, an improvement from 61.7% last year, even as we continue to invest in branches, technology and people.

product_mix.statement: Evaluating consumption-led products to fast-track growth; running internal pilots
product_mix.quote: We are running some pilot projects internally already, that how to expand it and fast track this particular subset within this particular product.

product_mix.statement: Consumption loans 7% of book, mostly cross-sell to existing customers; includes 1.5-2% loan against FDRs
product_mix.quote: Consumption, which is presently constituting 7% of the portfolio is typically the second or the third hook. What I mean by this, consumption is not our start point. Consumption is the second or the third hook to our existing customer.

risk.statement: No agriculture lending in Rajasthan yet; monitoring canal irrigation progress before entry
risk.quote: I can say, I started studying about Rajasthan since that is a new territory. But up to now, my initial study results are not that encouraging. So we have not opened the gates of agriculture in Rajasthan.

other.statement: SMA1+2 at 3.31% of advances, down from 4.78% QoQ and 4.42% YoY
other.quote: SMA1 and SMA2 accounts for around 3.31% of the advances, down from 4.78% a quarter back and 4.42% a year back.

other.statement: H1 FY27 annualized gross slippage 1.11%, net slippage 0.24%; no agri stress from deficit rainfall
other.quote: Even if we talk about the current year, we have a gross slippage for the H1FY27, 1.11% on annualized and net slippage of 0.24%, with our credit cost of 0.18% for Q2 and 0.24% for the H1.

guidance.statement: Aim to sustain double-digit profit growth, improve return ratios, grow to more than 1 lakh customers by 2027, and see wealth, merchant banking, and insurance contribute meaningfully to bottom line
guidance.quote: Our priorities are clear. We aim to sustain double -digit profit growth, improve our return ratios, grow to more than 1 lakh customers by 2027, and see wealth, merchant banking, and insurance contribute meaningfully to the bottom line.

demand.statement: Domestic institutions bought close to INR3.9 lakh crores of equities and monthly SIP contribution reached record INR32,400 crores in September
demand.quote: Over the same 6 months, domestic institutions bought close to INR3.9 lakh crores of equities. The monthly SIP contribution reached a record of over INR32,400 crores in September.

margin.statement: Consolidated net profit margin improved to 41.7% in H1 FY27
margin.quote: Our net profit margin improved to 41.7%.

order_book.statement: MTF book crossed INR100 crores and is fully collateralized by client shares and cash
order_book.quote: Our MTF book has crossed INR100 crores and is fully collateralized by our client shares and cash.

capex.statement: Plan to open flagship branches in high visibility locations, grow MTF book carefully, scale algo trading for retail investors, build Gift City merchant banking, secured lending, and insurance business
capex.quote: We will work towards this by opening flagship branches in high visibility locations, growing the MTF book carefully, scaling algo trading for retail investors, and building our Gift City merchant banking, secured lending, and insurance business.

pricing_cost.statement: Industry margin trading book grew from INR1.4 lakh crores to INR1.6 lakh crores; activity moving towards cash market and funded positions
pricing_cost.quote: Industry's margin trading book grew from over INR1.4 lakh crores at the end of June to about INR1.6 lakh crores by the end of September.

product_mix.statement: Added insurance distribution via subsidiary Pune Finvest with IRDAI corporate agency approval in July, began advisory operations in September under brand QURA Insure
product_mix.quote: In insurance, our subsidiary Pune Finvest received its IRDAI corporate agency approval in July this year, and we began advisory operations in September under our brand QURA Insure.

fund_raise.statement: Converted warrants into 18 lakh equity shares and issued 16 lakh new convertible warrants at INR234 each with 25% subscription received
fund_raise.quote: Apart from the profit for the half, this reflects the conversion of warrants into 18 lakh equity shares and the issue of 16 lakh new convertible warrants at INR234 each, on which 25% of the subscription amount has been received.

risk.statement: Regulatory risk is primary risk; SEBI and IRDAI changes may cause short-term margin pressure but long-term clarity benefits industry
risk.quote: So as and when new regulations or new notifications come in, we need to adapt to those guidelines and framework. And due to that, whatever risk, most of the industry players might have to face, we will also be facing that.

other.statement: Mutual fund distribution AUM over INR240 crores with SIP book over INR1.5 crores across 36 AMCs and 500+ schemes serving 1,600+ investors
other.quote: Our mutual fund distribution business works with 36 AMCs and more than 500 schemes. Serves more than 1,600 investors with overall AUM of over INR240 crores. Our SIP book is over INR1.5 crores.

other.statement: PESB Alpha Fund Category III AIF manages around INR55 crores, PESB invested INR15 crores, delivered about 25% post-fees post-tax return in first year
other.quote: The PESB Alpha Fund, our Category III AIF launched in November 2025, now manages around INR55 crores. PESB itself has invested INR15 crores in the fund.

guidance.statement: Internal aim is to deliver year-on-year top-line and bottom-line growth in H2 despite headwinds; Q3 expected to be tough.
guidance.quote: Internally, what we are aiming for is that just still manage to deliver year-on-year growth both on top line and bottom line. That is kind of like the framework we are working with right now.

guidance.statement: Constant currency GTV growth targeted for Q3; reported growth depends on currency appreciation which cannot be forecast.
guidance.quote: I am keeping fingers crossed for constant currency growth. The currency uplift is on top of it because that is, we do not contribute to it.

margin.statement: Adjusted EBITDA grew 27% on 16% GTV growth, demonstrating operating leverage for second consecutive quarter.
margin.quote: We have shared the numbers, but I do want to highlight that the 16% growth in GTV led to a 27% growth in adjusted EBITDA. So, we are continuing to demonstrate operating leverage for the second consecutive quarter.

margin.statement: Hotel GP margins held in Q2 despite Middle East competition; hope to maintain similar percentages if supply/demand balance unchanged.
margin.quote: If the situation, remains the same, we hope to continue with the similar kind of margins that we have achieved in Q2.

margin.statement: Long-term framework: SG&A investment should grow slower than GP growth; trailing 12-month EBITDA margins best gauge.
margin.quote: In the long run, conceptually, I feel we have gotten to a point where we know that the investment in SG&A should largely be less than the growth in GP that we are anticipating.

capex.statement: Investing in AI and technology to automate processes and build sales/operations tools; constant currency SG&A growth at high single digits.
capex.quote: We are continuing to invest in building or using AI and technology to automate processes, to build tools for our sales team to become more effective, and tools for our operations team to automate a fair bit of work that they do.

pricing_cost.statement: Air GP expected to range 1-1.2% depending on ad-hoc airline incentives; may recover in future quarters.
pricing_cost.quote: Generally the GP, what we have been telling as well is, should range between 1% to 1.2%. We may see some quarters it is lower, and sometimes it may recover in the next quarters as well.

risk.statement: Q3 headwinds: Saudi airport attacks hit inbound/outbound; European riots in Paris, Madrid, Barcelona, Italy causing cancellations; U.S. election outcome pending.
risk.quote: crisis in Saudi with the attacks happening on Saudi airports meant that both Saudi inbound and Saudi outbound has been very badly hit. Prior bookings have also gotten canceled. On top of it, the spread of rioting across major European cities has also been a major headwind

other.statement: Organic international GTV grew 28% in Q2; management expects 'reasonably more' once geopolitical recovery occurs.
other.quote: In the international market, even in this quarter, the organic growth is 28%. We would expect to do something reasonably more than that once recovery happens.

other.statement: Meaningful working capital release in Q2 from timing differences: Middle East receivables post-Eid, Brazil receivables, and shift from virtual credit cards to credit lines.
other.quote: For example, there were certain overdue, specifically in the Middle East, due to the war situation and the Eid at the March end, those receivables had got released. We had certain receivables because of the anticipation-related thing that we had not done in Brazil in the last year. Those receivables have been released.

guidance.statement: API segment targeting EBITDA breakeven over next 3-4 quarters; current loss run-rate ~INR5 cr +/- INR1 cr per quarter
guidance.quote: So no time lines as of now. I think consistently around you've seen the numbers, roughly INR5 crores plus/minus INR1 crores is roughly what we bleed as on today. But the endeavour is that over the next 3, 4 quarters, we should be breakeven in this segment.

guidance.statement: Zambia JV: $25 million revenue confirmed with margins slightly better than CDMO; commercial supplies from Indian plant in Q4 FY27, revenue booking in Q1 FY28; second $25 million round committed
guidance.quote: So that all remains consistent. And subsequently when we deliver this, we will again have a discussion on another $25 million round of supplies committed by the Government of Zambia.

guidance.statement: Domestic branded formulations to deliver growth on par with IPM by FY28 as current initiatives bear fruit
guidance.quote: We expect the segment to deliver growth on par with IPM by FY28 as the current initiatives start bearing fruits.

guidance.statement: International branded formulations expected to maintain growth momentum and be key engine for Akums growth
guidance.quote: It is expected to maintain this momentum going forward in the year and will be key engine to drive Akums' growth.

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin 14.5% in Q2 FY27 vs 9.3% YoY and 15% QoQ; CDMO EBITDA INR168 cr (+99.6% YoY, +2.9% QoQ); Domestic branded EBITDA INR24 cr (-8.9% YoY, +103% QoQ); International branded EBITDA INR9.9 cr (+80.5% YoY, +43.8% QoQ); AP
margin.quote: Margins were healthy at 14.5% as against 9.3% in Q2 FY26 and 15% in Q1 FY27. EBITDA with other income stood at INR224 crores, an increase of 76.3% year-on-year and an increase of 9.1% quarter-on-quarter.

order_book.statement: CDMO order cycle visibility of 60 days; strong order book driving >20% volume growth on September net MAT basis
order_book.quote: Led by strong order book and improved utilization of newer facilities, the CDMO business achieved a volume growth of more than 20% on September net MAT basis showcasing increasing penetration of our offering within the India pharma market.

capex.statement: H1 FY27 capex INR210 cr (includes Baddi plant ~INR43 cr and Oriflame acquisition ~INR56 cr); historical annual run-rate ~INR300 cr plus ~INR100 cr maintenance capex on INR2,400 cr gross block
capex.quote: So for this quarter, as I mentioned, there is an investment of INR210 crores. H1 total is INR210 crores that we made. So we historically have been around a number of close to INR300-odd crores. We see this slightly higher this time because we are operationalising Baddi and we've acquired this plant.

pricing_cost.statement: API prices up 2-3% QoQ and 5-7% YoY as a basket; slight upward trajectory expected in near term; input costs (KSMs, solvents, husk) also up dramatically
pricing_cost.quote: If you really look at it quarter-on-quarter, these have moved roughly 2% to 3%. While if we compare it to last quarter 2 FY26, these would have moved up by 5% to 7% as a basket. So this is on the API prices.

product_mix.statement: API segment focusing on higher gross margin products, removing low-margin SKUs, diversifying geographies (2 CEPs approved, 2 in pipeline, EDQM audit done); CDMO portfolio mimics Indian market therapy mix (~10-11% market share)
product_mix.quote: The focus of the management over there is how do we curtail the losses and by which, we are meaningfully driving it with improvement of our product mix as well as by product mix, I mean removing products which have low gross margins and focusing on general products which have better gross margins.

risk.statement: API price volatility (commodity-linked); Zambia shipping timeline 100-120 days delays revenue recognition; European dossier approval timing uncertain (1-2 quarters)
risk.quote: Since this like most of our CDMO is ex works. So in our factory once it leaves our warehouse, we book the revenue ex works. Here we have to deliver at Lusaka warehouse of the Zambian government. So that shipping time lines from Haridwar from where we'll mostly manufacture to Lusaka in Zambia is roughly 100 and 120 days.

other.statement: Current CDMO utilization above 50%; Oriflame plants (beauty & personal care) successfully integrated
other.quote: We today operate at healthy utilization levels of above 50%.

other.statement: Oriflame acquisition (2 plants, ~INR56 cr) integrated; peak revenue target 3x investment; color cosmetics ramp-up underway; negligible PAT contribution currently
other.quote: Oriflame, we bought it at around INR56 crores. This is again, as I was mentioning to an earlier question, we expect that peak should deliver a 3x revenue for us.

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue target INR13,000 crores plus; PAT margin 4% to 4.2%
guidance.quote: At a company level, we are targeting the revenues to be in the range of INR13,000 crores plus. That's the guidance we have already given in the market. And we see that this guidance is achievable as of now from the numbers which we have seen. PAT margin of 4% to 4.2% is what we have given the guidance earlier.

guidance.statement: Aspirational FY29 revenue around INR17,000 crores plus; CAGR FY27-29 ~25%
guidance.quote: We had done a 3-year plan, which is more of an aspirational plan, but it will be difficult to right now pin a number to it. On a broad level, we should be at around -- sorry, around INR17,000 crores plus by -- and I think our CAGR for FY '27 to '29 should be around 25% year-over-year

demand.statement: Navaratri revenue ~INR200 crores shifted to Q3; Diwali/wedding season outlook positive with soft gold prices driving volume
demand.quote: Yes, around -- if you look at the entire season of the 10 days of Navaratri, around INR200 crores would have been the revenue from those 10 days. So that revenue has been pushed to Q3.

demand.statement: Navaratri good, Diwali season (first 15 days Nov) expected good; lots of bookings and customer interest
demand.quote: Navaratri has been good and so the season looks positive as we speak. Prices have remained soft, and that has been also tempting of people to enter the market. So we are positive that Diwali should be -- Diwali season, the entire 1st November, first 15 days should be good. The indications are there are a lot of bookings, a lot of interest from people to make the purchases.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 8.4% (+186 bps YoY); adjusted EBITDA margin 8.2% (excl. INR5 cr unhedged gain)
margin.quote: Our EBITDA increased 57% to INR224.6 crores with a margin expanding 186 bps to 8.4%. Excluding an unhedged inventory gain of INR5 crores, adjusted EBITDA grew 60% to INR209.6 crores with an adjusted EBITDA margin improving to 8.2% from 6.3% a year ago.

margin.statement: Gross margin QoQ dip 50 bps due to franchisee mix rising to 17% from 12%
margin.quote: On the gross margins, you have picked up right that we have increased our gross margins on a year-on-year basis. And there is some dip on a Q-on-Q basis, primarily driven by the franchisee share increased to 17% from 12% in the Q-on-Q number. So that's the reason why the gross margin has reduced by 50 bps on quarter-to-quarter.

margin.statement: Franchisee growth dilutes gross margin but improves EBITDA margin and ROCE (no store opex/capex in PNG P&L)
margin.quote: So what happens, we have explained it earlier also when the -- at a gross margin level, the increase of franchisee dilutes the margin at a gross margin level. But at an EBITDA level, we are pretty much there. So that's the reason also even though the gross margin have shifted a bit on the Q-on-Q basis, my other expenses have come down because I don't have a cost to operate those stores into my P&L

capex.statement: FY28 onward: 50-50 COCO/FOCO split; targeting 30-35 stores/year (17-18 legacy, rest YOOU)
capex.quote: Going ahead, next year -- from next year onwards, we plan to do a 50-50 allocation between COCO and FOCO. And that too also in the legacy and the YOOU by PNG format, it will be 50-50. So what we're talking of adding around 30, 35 stores, out of which 17 to 18 stores would be legacy, half the balance would be YOOU by PNG.

capex.statement: Plan to open 23 new stores in FY27, total ~103 by year-end; 8-10 in Q3, rest in Q4
capex.quote: We remain on track to open around 23 new stores in FY '27, taking our total store count to approximately 103 by the year-end. Expansion will gather pace over the next 2 quarters, driven P N Gadgil Jewellers Limited October 30th, 2026 primarily by the franchisee-led model across both legacy and YOOU

pricing_cost.statement: Gold price softness driving volume growth; when prices fall, volume rises; when prices rise, value rises
pricing_cost.quote: See, we always maintain -- I mean, when prices come down, you'll see more volume. When prices go up, you'll see more value. So by that logic, yes.

product_mix.statement: YOOU stud ratio 53.1% (vs 32.9% last quarter); brand is ~70% diamond, 30% gold
product_mix.quote: We rebranded LiteStyle as YOOU by PNG, which is a lightweight diamond jewellery brand for younger style-conscious consumers and the response has been very encouraging with YOOU stud ratio rising to 53.1% from 32.9% last quarter.

other.statement: Revenue seasonality: H1 ~40%, H2 ~60% due to rainy season; PAT more skewed with ~1/3 in H1 and ~2/3 in H2 as expenses remain fixed

guidance.statement: Revenue growth target >20% annually for next 2-3 years; EBITDA margin 14-15%

guidance.statement: Full-year revenue target Rs 4,300-4,400 crore, implying ~20% growth; EBITDA margin target 14-15%

guidance.quote: Arjan Suja Rabari: Alok, at the end of this financial year, the order book that we will have, we are targeting around Rs. 10,000 crores. Which is more than 2.5 times of our expected revenue.

pricing_cost.statement: All contracts have price escalation clauses linked to WPI or bitumen rates, insulating margins from commodity volatility

product_mix.statement: Focus remains on EPC in water (irrigation, water supply, WTP, desalination); STP/ETP later; no PPP/developer plans
